english: Nysa stands on the Nysa Kłodzka in Silesia. From 1290 to 1742 it served as the capital of an episcopal duchy, becoming an important regional centre of printing and education in the early modern period.
simp_chinese: 尼斯位于西里西亚的克沃兹科尼斯河畔。1290至1742年间，它是主教公国首都，近世又成为重要的区域印刷和教育中心。

english: Nyssa belongs to the northern Paiute country within the broader Great Basin. Across this region, enclosed watersheds and dry basin-and-range landscapes distinguish the country from river systems that drain to the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 奈萨属于广义大盆地内的北派尤特地区。在这一区域，封闭流域及干旱的盆岭地貌使其与流入太平洋的河系形成差别。

english: Nystad belongs to Finland within the wider Nordic region. Across Finland and Sweden, numerous lakes and moraines record the legacy of the ice age that ended roughly ten thousand years ago.
simp_chinese: 尼斯塔德位于广义北欧地区的芬兰。在芬兰与瑞典，众多湖泊与冰碛地貌记录了约一万年前结束的冰期留下的遗产。

english: Nytva stands near its namesake river’s meeting with the Kama west of Perm. A copper-smelting works established in 1756 became an important feature of the settlement.
simp_chinese: 内特瓦位于彼尔姆以西、同名河流汇入卡马河处附近。1756年建立的炼铜厂成为聚落的重要组成部分。

english: Nyuele belongs to the Eastern Siberian country of Yakutia. The wider region includes great plateaus, northern tundra and southern ranges, stretching between the Yenisei and the Pacific divides. Its geographical boundaries overlap with, but differ from, those of the Russian Far East.
simp_chinese: 纽埃莱属于雅库特的东西伯利亚地区。广义区域包括巨大高原、北方苔原与南部山脉，延伸于叶尼塞河和太平洋分水岭之间。其地理边界与俄罗斯远东有所重叠，却并不相同。

english: Nyuksenitsa stands on the left bank of the Sukhona and first appears in written records in 1619. The river then formed an important transport link between Moscow and Arkhangelsk, Russia’s principal foreign-trade port before the rise of St Petersburg.
simp_chinese: 纽克谢尼察位于苏霍纳河左岸，最早见于1619年的文字记载。当时河流是莫斯科通往阿尔汉格尔斯克的重要交通线；在圣彼得堡兴起之前，后者是俄罗斯主要的对外贸易港。

english: Nyurum Yegan lies in the Nadym country of northwestern Siberia. The regional name appears in late sixteenth-century records and on later Russian maps. Semyon Remezov’s Drawing Book of Siberia, compiled in 1699–1701, recorded the Nadym River in this remote landscape.
simp_chinese: 纽鲁姆叶甘位于西伯利亚西北部纳德姆地区。地区名称见于十六世纪末记录及后来的俄国地图。谢苗·列梅佐夫于1699至1701年编纂的《西伯利亚绘图集》记下了这片偏远地域的纳德姆河。

english: Nyū belongs to the Fukui region of Japan’s former Echizen province. The modern district contains Echizen town, after several neighbouring settlements were merged into larger municipalities.
simp_chinese: 丹生属于日本旧越前国的福井地区。现代丹生郡包括越前町，周围一些聚落已合并进入较大的行政区。

english: Cape Nyūdō faces the Sea of Japan from the northern Japanese coast. Narrow straits regulate exchange with neighbouring seas, leaving relatively weak tides within the basin. Rich oxygen levels support the fisheries that connect coastal communities with these waters.
simp_chinese: 入道岬从日本北部海岸面向日本海。狭窄海峡调节与邻海交换，使海盆潮汐较弱。丰富氧气支撑渔业，将沿岸社群同水域相连。

english: Nyuya stands on the left bank of the Lena near its meeting with the Nyuya River. The settlement has a river port, and frozen winter waterways have provided an important seasonal route toward Lensk.
simp_chinese: 纽亚位于勒拿河左岸、邻近纽亚河汇入口。聚落设有河港，冬季冻结的水道为通往连斯克提供了重要的季节性通道。

english: Nyzhnia Duvanka lies in the Sloboda region of eastern Ukraine, within Luhansk oblast. The settlement received urban-type status in December 1960.
simp_chinese: 下杜万卡位于乌克兰东部斯洛博达地区，属卢甘斯克州。该聚落于1960年12月获得城镇型居民点地位。

english: Nyzvar lies in the Khwarazm country around Khiva. The regional centre developed over many centuries and later served as the capital of the Khanate of Khiva; its walled inner town is known as Itchan Kala.
simp_chinese: 奴兹瓦尔位于希瓦周围的花剌子模地区。地区中心经历了漫长的发展，后来成为希瓦汗国的都城；其城墙围合的内城称为伊钦卡拉。

english: This coast faces Nzeto, an Angolan commune. The settlement belongs to the country’s Zaire Province.
simp_chinese: 这段海岸面向安哥拉的恩泽托市镇。该聚落属于该国扎伊尔省。

english: Nzwani, also known as Anjouan, is a volcanic island of the Comoros with its chief town at Mutsamudu. Its early population combined Bantu-speaking settlers from eastern Africa with navigators from Indonesia and Southwest Asia, before Hadrami Arab immigrants entered the ruling families in the late fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 恩兹瓦尼又称昂儒昂，是科摩罗的一座火山岛，主要城镇为穆察穆杜。早期居民包括来自东非的班图语族移民，以及来自印度尼西亚和西亚的航海者；15世纪末，哈德拉毛阿拉伯移民又与当地统治家族联姻。

english: Oʻahu is the third-largest island in the Hawaiian chain. Honolulu occupies its southeastern coast, while smaller islands in Kāneʻohe Bay and along the windward shore accompany its long and varied coastline.
simp_chinese: 瓦胡岛是夏威夷群岛的第三大岛。檀香山位于其东南海岸，卡内奥赫湾和迎风海岸附近还分布着小岛，共同构成绵长而多样的海岸景观。

english: These uplands belong to the northern interior of the Chukchi Peninsula. The wider peninsula forms continental Asia’s eastern extremity, bounded by the Chukchi Sea, Bering Sea and Bering Strait, with the Chukotka Mountains occupying its central and western parts.
simp_chinese: 这片高地属于楚科奇半岛北部内陆。整个半岛构成亚洲大陆的最东端，由楚科奇海、白令海与白令海峡环绕，楚科奇山脉占据其中部和西部。

english: The O’nmilin Uplands belong to the broader Chukotka mountain country. Across the regional system, largely barren ridges extend between Chaun Bay and the Bering Sea, with about half the mountain area above the Arctic Circle. Chukchi settlements traditionally occupied only a few sheltered intermontane valleys.
simp_chinese: 奥恩米林高地属于更广阔的楚科奇山区。在区域山系内，大片荒瘠山脊伸展于恰翁湾与白令海之间，约一半山区位于北极圈以北。楚科奇人传统上只居住在少数较有庇护的山间谷地。

english: Oacco belongs to the Kwanza river country of Angola. The wider river reaches the Atlantic south of Luanda, and its navigable lower course provided the original route for Portuguese penetration into northern Angola.
simp_chinese: 奥阿科属于安哥拉宽扎河地区。更广阔的河流在罗安达以南注入大西洋，可通航的下游曾是葡萄牙人进入安哥拉北部的最初路线。

english: Oahaha belongs to the wider Missouri landscape of central North America. Across this broader territory, Mississippian communities built ceremonial mound centres from the ninth century onward, while the Osage and Missouria were present when Europeans arrived.
simp_chinese: 奥哈哈属于北美洲中部广义的密苏里地域。整个大区域自9世纪起出现密西西比文化社群营建的仪式土丘中心；欧洲人到来时，奥塞奇与密苏里亚等族群生活于此。

english: Oancea belongs to western Moldavia in Romania’s Galați region. Its commune consists of Oancea itself and Slobozia Oancea. Together they form a small community of roughly fifteen hundred inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 奥安恰位于罗马尼亚加拉茨地区的西摩尔达维亚。乡镇由奥安恰本村与斯洛博齐亚奥安恰组成，两村共同构成约一千五百人的小型社群。

english: Oando belongs to the wider Kongo region of Central Africa. The agricultural Bakongo communities became known for metalwork, pottery and raffia weaving, with interregional trade organised through tribute networks.
simp_chinese: 奥安多属于中非更广阔的刚果地区。以农业为生的巴刚果社群以金属工艺、制陶和拉菲草编织闻名，跨地区贸易通过贡赋网络组织起来。

english: Oapan belongs to the Mesoamerican country of southern Mexico. The broader cultural region was tied together by cultivated maize and other domesticated crops, alongside exchanges of cacao, obsidian and valued shells through long-distance trade.
simp_chinese: 奥阿潘属于墨西哥南部的美索美洲地区。更广阔的文化区域以玉米和其他驯化作物种植相连，并通过长途贸易交换可可、黑曜石与贵重贝壳。

english: The Ob flows north across western Siberia towards the Arctic Ocean. Formed by the Biya and Katun rivers from the Altai, it joins with the Irtysh to create one of the world's longest river systems.
simp_chinese: 鄂毕河向北流过西西伯利亚，最终通向北冰洋。它由源出阿尔泰山的比亚河与卡通河汇成，与额尔齐斯河共同组成世界上最长的河流系统之一。

english: Oban occupies a horseshoe-shaped bay on Scotland's Firth of Lorn. Kerrera shelters the harbour, while nearby Dunollie Castle overlooks a site fortified since the Bronze Age.
simp_chinese: 奥本位于苏格兰洛恩湾一处马蹄形海湾旁。凯勒拉岛为港湾提供遮蔽，附近邓诺利城堡所在地点自青铜时代起就有防御工事。

english: The waters near Obana belong to the Sea of Japan between the island arc and mainland Asia. Narrow connections with neighbouring seas limit the tides and control most water exchange.
simp_chinese: 尾花附近水域属于日本岛弧与亚洲大陆之间的日本海。通往邻海的狭窄通道限制潮汐，并控制大部分海水交换。

english: Obaska belongs to the broad inland country east of James Bay. At the regional scale, Jamésie forms a vast part of northern Quebec, centred on communities including Chibougamau. Its modern administrative geography has changed as Cree territories gained separate recognition.
simp_chinese: 奥巴斯卡属于詹姆斯湾以东广阔的内陆地区。从区域尺度看，雅梅西构成魁北克北部的一大片土地，以希布加莫等社区为中心。克里人领地获得独立承认后，现代行政区划也发生了变化。

english: Obdorsk stands beside the Ob River on the Arctic Circle. Russian settlers established it in 1595 on the site of the Khanty settlement of Polnovat-Vozh after the conquest of Siberia. Later renamed Salekhard, it remained a meeting point between river transport and the northern lands.
simp_chinese: 鄂毕多尔斯克位于北极圈上的鄂毕河畔。俄罗斯人在征服西伯利亚后，于1595年在汉特人聚落波尔诺瓦特沃日原址建立此城。它后来改称萨列哈尔德，继续连接河运与北方大地。

english: The Temotu coastal waters surround the easternmost island region of Solomon Islands. Lata, on Nendö, is the modern provincial centre, while the wider islands combine predominantly Melanesian Santa Cruz communities with Polynesian populations on Tikopia, Anuta and other islands.
simp_chinese: 特莫图沿海水域环绕着所罗门群岛最东部的岛屿区域。恩登多岛上的拉塔是现代省会，广义群岛中既有以美拉尼西亚人为主的圣克鲁斯社群，也有蒂科皮亚、阿努塔等岛的波利尼西亚居民。

english: Oberdorf belongs to the Allgäu region of southern Swabia. This country stretches from the Alpine foothills into the mountains, with the Lech and Iller as its principal rivers and a strong tradition of dairy production.
simp_chinese: 奥伯多夫属于施瓦本南部的阿尔高地区。这片地域从阿尔卑斯山麓延伸至山区，以莱希河和伊勒河为主要河流，并有浓厚的乳业传统。

english: Oberkirch belongs to the country around the Black Forest, the wooded mountain range beside the Upper Rhine. Forestry and ore mining shaped the wider region’s economy, while its valleys were settled by the Alemanni after the Roman period.
simp_chinese: 奥伯基希属于黑森林周边地区，这片林木繁茂的山地紧邻莱茵河上游。林业与矿石开采塑造了更广阔地区的经济，罗马时代之后，阿勒曼人在当地河谷定居。

english: Oberndorf belongs to the Black Forest region of southwestern Germany. The wider wooded mountain range is bounded by the Rhine Valley and gives rise to both the Danube and Neckar rivers.
simp_chinese: 奥伯恩多夫属于德国西南部的黑森林地区。更广阔的森林山地以莱茵河谷为界，多瑙河与内卡河都发源于此。

english: Obi is the principal island of an archipelago south of Halmahera and north of Buru and Seram. Its hilly terrain supports many springs and rivers, with Lake Kapi forming its largest lake.
simp_chinese: 奥比是哈马黑拉以南、布鲁和塞兰以北群岛的主岛。丘陵地形养育了众多泉水和河流，卡皮湖是岛上最大的湖泊。

english: Eastern Indonesia forms a sea-linked archipelago between Asia and Oceania. Maritime routes carried commerce and religious traditions between its scattered ports.
simp_chinese: 印度尼西亚东部构成亚洲与大洋洲之间由海路联系的群岛。海上通道在分散港口间传播商业与宗教传统。

english: Obidos lies in the Brazilian state of Pará between Santarém and Oriximiná. Its modern municipality extends across roughly twenty-eight thousand square kilometres of the Amazon country, while the town’s recorded municipal foundation dates to 23 September 1867.
simp_chinese: 奥比杜斯位于巴西帕拉州的圣塔伦与奥里希米纳之间。今天的市域覆盖约二万八千平方公里的亚马逊地区，城镇记载的建市日期为1867年9月23日。

english: Obion stands beside its namesake river in western Tennessee. The modern settlement began in 1872 as Obion Station, a stopping point on the Chesapeake, Ohio and Southwestern Railroad.
simp_chinese: 奥拜恩位于田纳西西部的同名河流旁。现代聚落始于1872年的奥拜恩车站，当时是切萨皮克—俄亥俄—西南铁路沿线的一处停靠点。

english: Obishikokaang lies in the broad Keewatin country of the Canadian interior. Keewatin, a name drawn from Algonquian words for the north wind, later designated a large district west of Hudson Bay. Its southern lands became parts of Manitoba and Ontario in 1912.
simp_chinese: 奥比希科康位于加拿大内陆广阔的基韦廷地区。基韦廷名称取自阿尔冈昆语族语言中表示北风的词，后来成为哈得孙湾以西广大行政区的名称。其南部土地于1912年划入马尼托巴与安大略。

english: This gulf forms part of the Sea of Azov, the shallow inland sea connected to the Black Sea by the Kerch Strait. River-borne sand, silt and shells have shaped its low shores, narrow spits and numerous bays.
simp_chinese: 这片海湾属于亚速海，这个浅内海通过刻赤海峡连接黑海。河流带来的沙、淤泥和贝壳塑造了低平海岸、狭长沙嘴和众多海湾。

english: Oblivskaya grew from a Cossack farmstead traditionally dated to 1744. The Chir River and nearby lakes once isolated the settlement during spring floods, eventually encouraging its inhabitants to move to higher ground.
simp_chinese: 奥布利夫斯卡亚由一处哥萨克农庄发展而来，传统上认为始建于1744年。奇尔河和附近湖泊曾在春季洪水期间使聚落与外界隔绝，居民后来因此迁往较高的地面。

english: Obock is a small port on the northern shore of the Gulf of Tadjoura, near its opening into the Gulf of Aden. The fishing village grew by a local wadi on the Dala-h Húgub plateau.
simp_chinese: 奥博克是塔朱拉湾北岸的小港口，邻近该湾通向亚丁湾的入口。渔村在达拉胡古布高地的一条当地旱河附近发展起来。

english: Obolensk belongs to the Upper Oka princely world around Tarusa. Tarusa itself was the centre of a principality by 1246, one of the small dynastic states that developed along this river frontier.
simp_chinese: 奥博连斯克属于塔鲁萨周围的奥卡河上游诸公国世界。塔鲁萨城本身在1246年已是公国中心，是沿这条河流边疆发展的小型王朝国家之一。

english: Oborniki received town rights before 1292 and developed as a royal town of Greater Poland. A Franciscan monastery founded by Bolesław the Pious added to its religious life in the thirteenth century.
simp_chinese: 奥博尔尼基在1292年之前获得城市权利，发展为大波兰的王室城镇。13世纪，虔诚者博莱斯瓦夫创立的方济各会修道院又丰富了当地宗教生活。

english: Oboyan stands where the Oboyanka joins the Psyol south of Kursk. It began in 1639 as a fortress on Russia's southern borderlands and received town status in 1779.
simp_chinese: 奥博扬位于库尔斯克以南奥博扬卡河汇入普肖尔河之处。它于1639年作为俄罗斯南部边疆的要塞建立，1779年取得城镇地位。

english: Obrestad Cape belongs to Norway’s Scandinavian coastline. The wider Scandinavian landscape is marked by western Norwegian fjords and a mountain chain extending through Norway and Sweden, in contrast to the flatter lands farther south.
simp_chinese: 奥布雷斯塔角属于挪威的斯堪的纳维亚海岸。广义斯堪的纳维亚以挪威西部峡湾和延伸于挪威、瑞典的山脉为地貌特征，更南方则分布较平坦的土地。

english: Obruk belongs to the central Anatolian country around Larende, later Karaman. The regional centre lies north of the Taurus Mountains and took its later name from Karaman Bey of the Karamanid dynasty.
simp_chinese: 奥布鲁克属于后来称作卡拉曼的拉伦代周围安纳托利亚中部地区。地区中心位于托罗斯山脉以北，其后来的名称源于卡拉曼王朝的卡拉曼贝伊。

english: Obyachevo lies in the Komi Republic of northeastern European Russia. The rural settlement serves as the centre of the Priluzsky district. Its Komi name, Abjaćoj, preserves the locality's place within the region's linguistic landscape.
simp_chinese: 奥比亚切沃位于欧洲俄罗斯东北部的科米共和国，是普里卢扎地区的乡村行政中心。科米语名称阿比亚乔伊保留了它在当地语言文化地域中的位置。

english: Ocaña belongs to the Toledo country of central Iberia. The wider peninsula became known to the Romans as Hispania, where conquest and local resistance unfolded over the centuries after the first Roman landing in 218 BCE.
simp_chinese: 奥卡尼亚属于伊比利亚中部的托莱多地区。更广阔的半岛被罗马人称为西班牙，公元前218年罗马首次登陆以后，征服与地方抵抗在数世纪间展开。

english: Ocanga belongs to the wider Congo country associated with Kinshasa. Kinshasa was known as Leopoldville from 1881 to 1966 and later became the capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
simp_chinese: 奥坎加属于与金沙萨相联系的广义刚果地区。金沙萨在1881至1966年间称利奥波德维尔，后来成为刚果民主共和国的首都。

english: The Occaneechi occupied the Piedmont borderlands of present-day Virginia and North Carolina. In the seventeenth century their principal settlement lay on a long island near the Dan and Roanoke confluence, until colonial militia attacks during Bacon’s Rebellion in 1676 devastated the community.
simp_chinese: 奥卡尼奇人居住在今弗吉尼亚与北卡罗来纳交界的皮德蒙特地区。17世纪，他们的主要聚落位于丹河与罗阿诺克河汇流处附近的一座长岛上，1676年培根叛乱期间的殖民民兵袭击重创了这一社群。

english: Oceko Sipiy belongs to the wider lands west of Hudson Bay known as Keewatin. This Cree or Ojibwe-derived name means 'north wind'. The nineteenth-century administrative district later shrank through transfers to neighbouring provinces, leaving a northern region incorporated into Nunavut in 1999.
simp_chinese: 奥切科西比属于哈得孙湾以西称为基韦廷的更广阔土地。这个源自克里语或奥吉布瓦语的名称意为“北风”。十九世纪设立的行政区后来因土地划给邻省而缩小，剩余北部地区于1999年纳入努纳武特。

english: Ochechiton belongs to the wider historical setting of the Michigamea, a people of the Illinois Confederation. Their communities moved through the Mississippi and Illinois country, and surviving accounts leave their original language affiliation uncertain.
simp_chinese: 奥切奇顿处于伊利诺伊联盟成员米奇加米人的广义历史区域。其群体曾迁徙于密西西比河与伊利诺伊地区，留存记述对其原始语言归属仍不确定。

english: Ocheydan belongs to northwestern Iowa’s prairie country. The broader region is bounded on the west by the Missouri and Big Sioux rivers and on the east by the Mississippi.
simp_chinese: 奥切耶丹属于艾奥瓦西北部的草原地区。更广阔的区域西以密苏里河与大苏河为界，东接密西西比河。

english: Ochi belongs to the old Iyo region of western Shikoku, now Ehime. The wider province has a long maritime tradition, with fishermen and sailors involved in coastal defense before and during the medieval period.
simp_chinese: 越智属于四国西部的古伊予地区，今属爱媛。整个地区有悠久的海洋传统，渔民和水手在中世纪及此前便参与海岸防卫。

english: Ochiishi Cape belongs to Hokkaido, the island long known in Japanese sources as Ezo. The historical term could extend to Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands, linking the coast to a broader northern island world associated with the Ainu.
simp_chinese: 落石岬属于北海道，这座岛屿在日本文献中长期称为虾夷。历史上的虾夷一词也可延伸至萨哈林和千岛群岛，将此处海岸与阿伊努人相关的更广北方岛屿世界联系起来。

english: The Ochil Hills form an escarpment north of Scotland’s Forth valley. Ancient volcanic rocks and the Ochil Fault shaped their steep southern face, while streams cut deep glens into the uplands. Ben Cleuch rises to 721 metres, above a rolling plateau crossed by only a few major routes.
simp_chinese: 奥希尔丘陵在苏格兰福斯河谷北侧形成陡崖。古老火山岩与奥希尔断层塑造了南面的陡坡，溪流则在高地切出深谷。本克卢赫山高721米，下方是起伏台地，只有少数主要道路穿越其间。

english: Ochyor developed beside a tributary of the Kama in the western Urals. The settlement was founded in 1759 around Count Stroganov’s iron foundry and ironworks. Metalworking remained central to its later economy, while gravel and peat deposits occur in the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 奥乔尔兴起于乌拉尔西部、卡马河的一条支流畔。1759年，聚落围绕斯特罗加诺夫伯爵的铸铁厂与炼铁厂建立。金属加工此后长期占据经济核心，周边地区还分布砂砾与泥炭。

english: Ockelbo lies in the Swedish province of Gästrikland. The community is known for its summer and winter markets and the gardens at Wij, combining a local gathering place with a distinctive horticultural landscape.
simp_chinese: 奥克尔布位于瑞典耶斯特里克兰地区。这里以夏冬两季集市及维伊花园闻名，将地方会聚场所与独特园艺景观结合在一起。

english: The Ocmulgee country lies along the waterways of central Georgia, where the river joins the Oconee to form the Altamaha. Its floodplain preserves a long Indigenous past, from early hunters to the ceremonial mounds, farmsteads and gardens of Mississippian communities. In the late seventeenth century towns moved here from the Chattahoochee, forming a cluster of Muscogee- and Hitchiti-speaking settlements. English traders called this waterway Ochese Creek, a name that contributed to their designation of the Creek people. After the Yamasee War began in 1715, many of these towns moved west again, becoming part of the Lower Towns of the Muscogee Confederacy.
simp_chinese: 奥克马尔吉地区沿佐治亚中部水道展开，奥克马尔吉河在这里与奥科尼河汇合，形成阿尔塔马哈河。河漫滩保存着悠久的原住民历史，从早期猎人延续到密西西比文化社群的仪式土丘、农庄与园圃。十七世纪末，来自查塔胡奇河的城镇迁入此地，形成一组使用马斯科吉语和希奇蒂语的聚落。英国商人将这条水道称为奥奇斯溪，这个名称也参与形成了他们对克里克人的称呼。1715年亚马西战争爆发后，许多城镇再次西迁，成为马斯科吉联盟下城各镇的一部分。

english: Ocoa Bay belongs to the Caribbean coast of Hispaniola. The wider Caribbean is a sea of island arcs, reefs and banks linking North and South America. Archaeological traces on Hispaniola place the island within the region’s long history of human settlement.
simp_chinese: 奥科阿湾属于伊斯帕尼奥拉的加勒比海岸。更广阔的加勒比海由岛弧、礁石和浅滩组成，连接着北美洲与南美洲。伊斯帕尼奥拉的考古遗迹将这座岛屿纳入地区悠久的人类定居史。

english: Ocol lies in the Chaco country associated with the Mocoví. Across this wider region, hunters took deer and rhea and made temporary shelters, while trade through the forest exchanged local skins and feathers for metal objects; Jesuit missions later promoted a more settled agricultural life.
simp_chinese: 奥科尔位于与莫科维人相联系的查科地区。在这一大区，猎人捕获鹿与美洲鸵，搭建临时住所，森林贸易以当地兽皮、羽毛交换金属制品；耶稣会传教站后来推动定居农业生活。

english: Oconee was one of the southeastern tribal towns associated with the Hitchiti language. Hitchiti-speaking communities formed part of the riverine world linking the Chattahoochee and Ocmulgee valleys.
simp_chinese: 奥科尼是北美东南部使用希契提语的部落城镇之一。希契提语社群构成了连接查塔胡奇河谷与奥克穆尔吉河谷的河流文化世界。

english: Oconto belongs to the Great Lakes country of Wisconsin. The wider region has a long Indigenous history extending back to the end of the Ice Age, when early hunters pursued animals including mastodons.
simp_chinese: 奥康托属于威斯康星的五大湖地区。更广阔的区域拥有可追溯至冰期末的悠久原住民历史，当时早期猎人追逐乳齿象等动物。

english: Ocosingo is a town and extensive surrounding district in Chiapas. The Usumacinta forms part of its northeastern boundary, where the river also marks a section of the frontier between Mexico and Guatemala.
simp_chinese: 奥科辛戈是恰帕斯的一座城镇及其周围广阔地区。乌苏马辛塔河构成其东北部的部分边界，河流在这里也划分了墨西哥与危地马拉的一段国境。

english: Ocotelolco was one of the four allied polities of Tlaxcallan. Its principal market gave it economic strength, and at the Spanish arrival its ruler Maxixcatzin headed one of the confederation’s most powerful communities.
simp_chinese: 奥科特洛尔科是特拉斯卡兰四个结盟邦国之一。主要市场为它带来经济实力，西班牙人抵达时，统治者马克西什卡钦领导着联盟中最强大的社群之一。

english: Ocotepec belongs to the broader Central American country associated with Cuzcatlan. The neighbouring Nahua state confederation extended between the Paz and Lempa rivers and showed cultural connections with Maya and Toltec traditions.
simp_chinese: 奥科特佩克属于与库斯卡坦相联系的中美洲广阔地区。邻近的纳瓦人国家联盟延展于帕斯河与伦帕河之间，并与玛雅和托尔特克传统有文化联系。

english: Ocro lies in the Peruvian coastal country associated with Chan Chan. This great adobe capital of Chimor depended on rivers descending from the Andes to irrigate an otherwise exceptionally arid desert landscape.
simp_chinese: 奥克罗位于与昌昌城相关的秘鲁沿海地区。这座奇穆尔的大型土坯都城依赖从安第斯山流下的河水，灌溉原本极为干旱的沙漠地貌。

english: Ocuogun belongs to the Yana river country of northern Sakha. Across the wider basin, the river crosses the Yana–Indigirka Lowland before entering the Laptev Sea through a broad delta. Its surface freezes in October, with the principal breakup and flood arriving in May and June.
simp_chinese: 奥库奥贡属于萨哈北部的亚纳河地区。在更广阔的流域，河流穿过亚纳—因迪吉尔卡低地，经宽广三角洲流入拉普捷夫海。河面十月封冻，主要解冻与洪水期在五至六月。

english: Ocute was a Late Mississippian chiefdom centred on the Oconee River valley in Georgia. Its alliance developed around 1325, and its ruler exercised authority over neighbouring communities before seventeenth-century Westo raids helped force their relocation.
simp_chinese: 奥库特是以佐治亚奥科尼河谷为中心的密西西比文化晚期酋邦。其联盟约于1325年形成，统治者对邻近社区行使权威，直到十七世纪韦斯托人的袭击促使居民迁移。

english: Oda Boru Ruva belongs to the Tana hinterland of the wider Swahili coastal region. The coast itself was known as Zanj in medieval Middle Eastern, Indian and Chinese literature, and its merchants participated in Indian Ocean exchange.
simp_chinese: 奥达博鲁鲁瓦属于广义斯瓦希里海岸地区的塔纳河腹地。沿海本身在中世纪中东、印度和中国文献中被称为赞吉，当地商人参与印度洋交流。

english: The Odawa linked the Great Lakes through far-reaching networks of exchange, and their name is commonly associated with trading. Their communities extended into Wisconsin after the seventeenth century, while canoes carried goods between lakes and inland peoples. Alongside the Ojibwe and Potawatomi, they formed the Council of Three Fires. In the fur-trade era, Odawa merchants became important intermediaries at Green Bay and Sault Ste. Marie, exchanging pelts for iron tools, kettles, cloth and other imported goods.
simp_chinese: 奥达瓦人以广泛的交换网络连接五大湖地区，其族名通常也与贸易相联系。17世纪以后，他们的社群扩展到威斯康星，独木舟则在湖区与内陆诸族之间运送货物。奥达瓦人与奥吉布瓦人、波塔瓦托米人组成了三火议会。在毛皮贸易时代，奥达瓦商人成为绿湾与苏圣玛丽一带的重要中间人，以毛皮换取铁器、锅、布匹和其他舶来货物。

english: The O'dam belong to the Tepehuán peoples of Mexico's western mountains. Before the Spanish conquest, Tepehuán territories extended along the Sierra Madre Occidental, with related communities retaining distinct languages, customs and beliefs.
simp_chinese: 奥达姆人属于墨西哥西部山区的特佩瓦人。西班牙征服之前，特佩瓦人的土地沿西马德雷山脉展开，各支社群保留着不同的语言、习俗与信仰。

english: Oddernes takes its name from an old farm beside the Otra, with the final element meaning peninsula. The historical parish and later municipality occupied country around what became Kristiansand, although their boundaries differed from those of the present urban borough.
simp_chinese: 奥德内斯得名于奥特拉河旁的一座旧农场，地名末尾意为半岛。历史教区与后来的市镇涵盖了后来克里斯蒂安桑周围的地域，其边界与今日城区并不相同。

english: Odemira preserves traces of settlement from before Roman times, followed by Roman and Islamic rule. Under Christian control by 1238, it received a municipal charter from Afonso III in 1256 that defined its territory and retained elements of earlier administration.
simp_chinese: 奥德米拉保存着前罗马时代的聚居遗迹，此后经历罗马与伊斯兰政权统治。至1238年这里已受基督教势力控制，阿方索三世于1256年颁发市镇特许状，划定辖境并保留部分早期行政传统。

english: Odense grew beside its river on the island of Funen and was recorded by name in 988. The killing of King Canute IV in St Alban's church in 1086 and his subsequent canonisation made the town an important pilgrimage centre. Churches and monasteries accompanied a prosperous medieval community of merchants and craftsmen, which received a charter in 1335. In 1482 the printer Johann Snell produced a prayer book here, among the earliest printed works in Scandinavia. After the Reformation, cattle trading helped finance substantial merchant houses, linking the town's religious heritage with the wealth of the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 欧登塞在菲英岛上的河畔发展起来，988年已有其名称的文字记载。1086年，国王克努特四世在圣阿尔班教堂遇害；此后他被封圣，使城镇成为重要的朝圣中心。教堂和修道院伴随着商人与工匠组成的繁荣社区成长，城镇于1335年获得特许状。1482年，印刷师约翰·斯内尔在这里印制祈祷书，属于斯堪的纳维亚最早的一批印刷作品。宗教改革之后，牲畜贸易为富丽的商人住宅提供资金，将城镇的宗教遗产与周边乡村的财富连接起来。

english: Odienné in northwestern Ivory Coast became the capital of the Kabadougou kingdom under Vakaba Touré in the nineteenth century. His tomb remains in the town. A large mosque and nearby gold mines reflect its religious and economic setting, while Samory Touré later used it as a support base.
simp_chinese: 奥迭内位于科特迪瓦西北部，十九世纪在瓦卡巴·图雷统治下成为卡巴杜古王国首都，其墓仍在城中。大清真寺和附近金矿体现了当地宗教与经济环境，萨莫里·图雷后来也曾将此地作为支援基地。

english: Odintsovo began as a village associated with Andrey Odinets in the late fourteenth century. Land southwest of Moscow was granted to him for service to Dmitry Donskoy. The settlement later became a western suburb of Moscow and received town status in 1957.
simp_chinese: 奥金佐沃起源于十四世纪末与安德烈·奥金涅茨有关的村落。他因效力于德米特里·顿斯科伊而获赐莫斯科西南土地。聚落后来成为莫斯科西郊的一部分，并于1957年获得城市地位。

english: Odoli belongs to the wider Songhua river country of northeastern Asia. Rising in the Changbai Mountains, the Songhua crosses broad plains where its changing course has left many oxbow lakes.
simp_chinese: 鄂多理属于东北亚更广阔的松花江地区。松花江发源于长白山，穿过广阔平原，变迁的河道留下了许多牛轭湖。

english: Odonga is associated with Ondonga, a traditional Ovambo kingdom in northern Namibia. Its Ndonga-speaking people call themselves Aandonga, and kings rule with a council of elders; royal succession follows the maternal line, with brothers and sisters’ sons holding important claims.
simp_chinese: 奥东加与纳米比亚北部奥万博人的传统王国翁东加相联系。使用恩东加语的居民自称Aandonga，国王与长老议事会共同治理；王位继承遵循母系，兄弟和姐妹之子拥有重要继承资格。

english: Odorheiu Secuiesc, or Székelyudvarhely, is one of the historic centres of Székely Land in Transylvania. Recorded in a papal register in 1334, the town retained civic rights reaffirmed by Prince Gabriel Bethlen in 1615.
simp_chinese: 奥多尔黑尤塞库耶斯克，又称塞凯尤德沃尔海伊，是特兰西瓦尼亚塞凯伊地区的历史中心之一。1334年的教廷税册已记载此城，加布里埃尔·拜特伦亲王又于1615年重申其城市权利。

english: Odoyev overlooks the Upa, a tributary of the Oka. It became a princely seat in 1376 when Roman Semyonovich moved there from Novosil, and its rulers long retained the older Novosil title.
simp_chinese: 奥多耶夫俯临奥卡河的支流乌帕河。1376年，罗曼·谢苗诺维奇从诺沃西利迁来，使这里成为王公驻地，其统治者此后长期保留诺沃西利的旧称号。

english: Oeno is a coral atoll northwest of Pitcairn Island in the South Pacific. Its broad lagoon and surrounding reef enclose only a small collection of low islets, whose combined land area is less than one square kilometre.
simp_chinese: 奥埃诺是南太平洋皮特凯恩岛西北方的一座珊瑚环礁。宽阔的潟湖与周围礁环之间只有几座低矮小岛，陆地总面积不足一平方公里。

english: The seas toward Oeno adjoin the southeastern Tuamotu island world. Nearby Tureia is an atoll whose lagoon has no navigable entrance and whose eastern reef is covered by a long island.
simp_chinese: 通往奥埃诺的海域邻接土阿莫土群岛东南部的岛屿世界。附近的图雷亚是一座潟湖没有可通航入口的环礁，其东侧礁缘被一座狭长岛屿覆盖。

english: Oettingen offers an unusually visible record of the religious divisions of southern Germany. Between 1522 and 1731 the town was shared by the Protestant house of Oettingen-Oettingen and the Catholic house of Oettingen-Wallerstein. One side of its main street and market developed half-timbered facades, while the other acquired Baroque fronts. The two communities even followed different calendars, Julian and Gregorian. Older layers survive in the town hall, whose stone entrance dates from 1431 and upper timberwork from 1480, and in the remains of the medieval gate tower.
simp_chinese: 厄廷根以格外直观的方式保留着德意志南部宗教分裂的痕迹。1522至1731年间，城镇由新教的厄廷根-厄廷根家族与天主教的厄廷根-瓦勒施泰因家族分有。主要街道和市场的一侧呈现木构建筑立面，另一侧则形成巴洛克式外观。两个群体甚至分别使用儒略历和格里高利历。更早的历史层次仍保留在市政厅和中世纪城门塔遗迹中：市政厅的石砌入口建于1431年，上层木构与屋架则出自1480年。

english: Oevemanaho belongs to the wider Great Plains of North America. This broad interior country lies east of the Rocky Mountains and is extensively covered by prairie, grassland and steppe.
simp_chinese: 奥维马纳霍属于北美更广阔的大平原。这片广大内陆地区位于落基山脉以东，广泛覆盖着草原、草地与干草原。

english: Ofaie belongs to the Tacuru region of Mato Grosso do Sul, near Brazil's border with Paraguay. In the wider regional centre, Guarani shares official status with Portuguese, reflecting the continued presence of Indigenous languages.
simp_chinese: 奥法耶属于南马托格罗索的塔库鲁地区，靠近巴西与巴拉圭边界。当地地区中心将瓜拉尼语与葡萄牙语并列为官方语言，反映了原住民语言的延续。

english: Offa lies in Nigeria’s Kwara State and is known for weaving, dyeing and pottery. Locally grown indigo supplies vegetable dyes, while Aso Oke cloth production and the traditional wrestling practice called Ìjàkadì form important parts of local culture.
simp_chinese: 奥法位于尼日利亚夸拉州，以织造、染色及制陶著称。当地种植的靛蓝植物提供染料，阿绍奥凯布制作与称为伊贾卡迪的传统摔跤构成地方文化的重要部分。

english: Offenbach stands on the Main in central Germany. The river flows west through Bavaria and Hesse to the Rhine, linking Offenbach and Frankfurt with a much wider inland waterway system.
simp_chinese: 奥芬巴赫位于德国中部美因河畔。河流向西穿越巴伐利亚与黑森汇入莱茵河，将奥芬巴赫、法兰克福与更广阔内陆水道系统相连。

english: Offenburg stands where the Kinzig valley opens from the Black Forest towards the Rhine plain. First mentioned in 1148, it had become a free imperial city by 1240, enjoying a place among the self-governing towns of the Holy Roman Empire. War repeatedly exposed the settlement's vulnerability: French forces destroyed almost the entire town in September 1689 during the Nine Years' War. The reordering of Germany in 1803 ended its imperial freedom and placed it under Baden, closing a long chapter of urban independence beside the Black Forest routes.
simp_chinese: 奥芬堡位于金齐希河谷从黑森林通向莱茵平原的出口。它于1148年首次见于文献，到1240年已成为帝国自由城市，跻身神圣罗马帝国的自治城镇之列。战争屡次暴露出聚落的脆弱：九年战争期间，法军于1689年9月摧毁了几乎整座城镇。1803年的德意志领土重组终结了其帝国自由地位，将它划归巴登，结束了这座黑森林道路旁城市长期自治的一章。

english: Offerdal is a highland parish of Jämtland, with the Oldfjällen range rising above its farming country. Agriculture has a long history in the southern part of the district, while the highest summit, Makkene, reaches 1,266 metres.
simp_chinese: 奥弗达尔是耶姆特兰的一片高地教区，奥尔德山脉耸立在农耕地区之上。南部有悠久的农业传统，最高的马凯内峰海拔达1266米。

english: Ofhidro Lake belongs to the southern Patagonian world. Across the wider region, Andean lakes, glaciers, fjords and temperate rainforests contrast with eastern steppes and tablelands. The Pacific and Atlantic frame this southern end of South America, linked by passages including the Magellan Strait and Beagle Channel.
simp_chinese: 奥菲德罗湖属于南巴塔哥尼亚世界。在更广阔的区域，安第斯湖泊、冰川、峡湾与温带雨林，同东部草原和台地形成对照。太平洋与大西洋环绕南美洲南端，经麦哲伦海峡、比格尔水道等通路相连。

english: Ofoten forms the northeastern traditional district of Nordland, on the rugged northern Norwegian coast. The region is cut by many fjords, and Ofotfjorden is listed among its principal and longest inlets.
simp_chinese: 奥福滕是诺尔兰东北部的传统地区，位于挪威北部崎岖的海岸。整个地区遍布峡湾，奥福特峡湾是其中主要且绵长的海湾之一。

english: The sea off Cape Ofuyu lies on the Japanese side of the Sea of Japan, enclosed by the Japanese archipelago, Sakhalin, Korea and the Russian mainland. Its limited connections to the open Pacific produce small tides, while oxygen-rich waters support productive fisheries.
simp_chinese: 雄冬岬外海位于日本海的日本一侧，这片海域被日本列岛、萨哈林岛、朝鲜半岛和俄罗斯大陆环绕。它与太平洋的通道有限，潮汐较小，而富含氧气的海水孕育了丰富渔场。

english: Ogain belongs to the wider Kalahari country of southern Africa. The region is a vast semiarid sandy savanna covering much of Botswana and extending into Namibia and South Africa, with many areas lacking permanent surface water.
simp_chinese: 奥盖因属于非洲南部更广阔的卡拉哈里地区。该地区是大片半干旱沙质稀树草原，覆盖博茨瓦纳大部并延伸至纳米比亚和南非，许多地方缺乏常年地表水。

english: The sea around Ogasawara surrounds an isolated archipelago south of Japan. The islands’ separation encouraged distinctive wildlife; although prehistoric Micronesian remains have been found, they were uninhabited when Spanish navigator Bernardo de la Torre sighted Hahajima in 1543.
simp_chinese: 小笠原远海环绕日本以南的孤立群岛。长期隔绝孕育了独特生物；尽管发现了史前密克罗尼西亚遗存，西班牙航海者贝尔纳多·德·拉托雷于1543年看到母岛时，群岛已无人居住。

english: These waters surround the isolated Ogasawara or Bonin Islands. More than thirty subtropical and tropical islands stand far south of Tokyo. Their long isolation fostered distinctive plants and animals, while archaeological finds show prehistoric Micronesian habitation before the islands were encountered uninhabited in the early modern period.
simp_chinese: 这片水域环绕孤立的小笠原群岛，又称博宁群岛。三十多座亚热带与热带岛屿远在东京以南。长期隔绝孕育了独特动植物；考古发现表明史前密克罗尼西亚人曾在此居住，但近代早期航海者到来时群岛已无人居住。

english: The Ogasawara Islands High Sea lies on the northern approaches to the Micronesian Pacific. Farther south, the broader island world includes the Marianas, Carolines, Marshalls and Gilberts. Thousands of small islands occupy only a tiny land area within an immense expanse of ocean.
simp_chinese: 小笠原群岛远海位于密克罗尼西亚太平洋世界的北方通路。更南方的广阔群岛世界包括马里亚纳、加罗林、马绍尔和吉尔伯特群岛。数千座小岛在辽阔海洋中只占极少陆地。

english: These waters surround the isolated Ogasawara, or Bonin, islands of the western Pacific. More than thirty subtropical and tropical islands form the group, whose remoteness fostered distinctive wildlife; Spanish navigator Bernardo de la Torre sighted Haha-jima in 1543.
simp_chinese: 这片海水环绕西太平洋孤远的小笠原群岛，又称博宁群岛。三十余座亚热带和热带岛屿构成群岛，隔绝环境孕育独特生物；西班牙航海家贝尔纳多·德拉托雷于1543年望见母岛。

english: These waters surround the wider Ogasawara archipelago, more than thirty subtropical and tropical islands far south of Tokyo. Their oceanic isolation produced many distinctive plants and animals, while prehistoric tools reveal earlier Micronesian visits or settlement.
simp_chinese: 这片水域环绕更广阔的小笠原群岛，群岛由东京以南远处三十多个亚热带与热带岛屿组成。海洋隔离孕育了许多独特动植物，史前工具则显示密克罗尼西亚人曾到访或居住。

english: These open waters surround the isolated Bonin or Ogasawara Islands south-southeast of Japan. The wider archipelago contains more than thirty subtropical and tropical islands, whose long isolation fostered distinctive plants and animals.
simp_chinese: 这片远海围绕日本东南偏南方孤立的小笠原群岛。整个群岛由三十多个亚热带与热带岛屿组成，长期隔绝孕育了独特的动植物。

english: The waters around Ogasawara surround an isolated Japanese archipelago far southeast of Tokyo. The islands’ long isolation fostered distinctive plants and animals, while archaeological finds show some prehistoric Micronesian habitation.
simp_chinese: 小笠原周围海域环绕着东京东南远海的一组孤立日本群岛。长期隔绝孕育了独特动植物，考古发现也显示史前曾有密克罗尼西亚人居住。

english: These waters lie around the Bonin Islands, more than a thousand kilometres south-southeast of Tokyo. The isolated subtropical archipelago developed distinctive wildlife, while stone tools and carved stones attest to prehistoric human visits.
simp_chinese: 这片海域位于东京东南偏南一千多公里外的小笠原群岛周围。孤立的亚热带群岛形成了独特的野生生物，石器和刻石则见证了史前人类的到访。

english: These waters surround the isolated Bonin or Ogasawara Islands south-southeast of Japan. The neighbouring subtropical islands developed many distinctive plants and animals through their long isolation.
simp_chinese: 这片水域环绕日本东南偏南方向孤立的小笠原群岛。邻近亚热带岛屿因长期隔绝演化出许多独特动植物。

english: Ogbomosho is a Yoruba city in the Oyo region of southwestern Nigeria. Founded in the middle of the seventeenth century, it later developed into a large walled settlement whose inhabitants maintained connections across the region.
simp_chinese: 奥博莫绍是尼日利亚西南部奥约地区的一座约鲁巴城市。它建立于十七世纪中叶，后来发展成规模可观的设防聚落，居民与周边地区保持着广泛联系。

english: The Ogeechee flows southeast across Georgia to Ossabaw Sound. Below its upper shoals, the river winds through cypress swamps and forests in country occupied by Mississippian and Yuchi communities before European arrival.
simp_chinese: 奥吉奇河向东南流经佐治亚，注入奥萨博湾。越过上游浅滩后，河流蜿蜒穿过柏树沼泽和森林，欧洲人到来前这里曾有密西西比文化与尤奇社群居住。

english: Ogiciza Wakpa belongs to Saskatchewan’s wider interior landscape. The region combines southern prairies with a northern forest belt, threaded by numerous rivers and lakes.
simp_chinese: 奥吉奇扎瓦克帕属于萨斯喀彻温更广阔的内陆景观。这片地区兼有南部草原与北部森林带，其间分布着众多河流和湖泊。

english: Ogoja brings together several communities in the Cross River country, with Igoli forming its central town. Among the surrounding peoples are the Mbube, whose subsistence farming includes cassava and yams alongside products from oil palms.
simp_chinese: 奥戈贾汇集了克罗斯河地区的多个社群，伊戈利构成其中心城镇。周边居民包括姆布贝人，他们的自给农业种植木薯、薯蓣，并生产油棕相关产品。

english: The Ogoki River winds through northern Ontario to join the Albany, whose waters reach James Bay. Its channels alternate slow, sediment-rich reaches with rapids over bedrock shelves. Canoe routes along the Ogoki linked Hudson Bay with Lake Nipigon and Lake Superior through a series of rivers and portages.
simp_chinese: 奥戈基河蜿蜒流过安大略北部，汇入流向詹姆斯湾的奥尔巴尼河。河道交替出现富含泥沙的缓流和越过基岩的急滩。沿河独木舟路线通过河流与搬船陆道，将哈德逊湾同尼皮贡湖和苏必利尔湖连接起来。

english: Ogoki Lake lies in Ontario’s Thunder Bay district. The Ogoki River both feeds and drains the lake, placing it within a continuous river route through the northern lake country.
simp_chinese: 奥戈基湖位于安大略的桑德贝地区。奥戈基河既向湖中注水，也将湖水排出，使它成为北方湖区相连河流通路的一部分。

english: The Ogoki uplands feed a river route toward James Bay. Flowing north of Lake Nipigon, the Ogoki joins the Albany River; its channels, rapids and portages once formed part of the canoe connection between Hudson Bay and Lake Superior.
simp_chinese: 奥戈基高地为通向詹姆斯湾的河道提供水源。奥戈基河流经尼皮贡湖以北，汇入奥尔巴尼河；其汊道、急流与陆运转接点曾是哈德逊湾至苏必利尔湖独木舟路线的一部分。

english: Ögomöör belongs to the Zavkhan country of western Mongolia. This broader western landscape combines cold mountains with steppe, within a plateau where mobile pastoralism long outweighed crop cultivation.
simp_chinese: 额格穆尔属于蒙古西部的扎布汗地区。更广阔的西部地貌结合寒冷山地与草原，而在这片高原上，流动畜牧业长期比作物耕种更为重要。

english: Ogonok belongs to the continental Okhotsk coast of eastern Siberia. The wider shoreline is deeply indented by headlands, peninsulas and bays, including the great Shelikhov Gulf in the sea’s north.
simp_chinese: 奥戈诺克属于东西伯利亚大陆的鄂霍次克海岸。更广阔的海岸线由岬角、半岛与海湾深切分割，其中包括海域北方辽阔的舍利霍夫湾。

english: The Ogoowe Coast belongs to the Gabonese margin of Central Africa. In the wider Central African region, archaeological finds attest to human activity more than one hundred thousand years ago.
simp_chinese: 奥果韦海岸属于中非的加蓬沿海边缘。在更广阔的中非地区，考古发现见证了超过十万年前的人类活动。

english: Ogoowe belongs to the Gabonese part of the Central African region. Across the broader region, the Congo basin has played an important ecological role, and archaeological finds record a human past stretching back more than a hundred thousand years.
simp_chinese: 奥果韦属于中非地区的加蓬部分。在更广阔区域中，刚果盆地发挥重要生态作用，考古发现记载的人类历史超过十万年。

english: The Ogooué drains much of Gabon from headwaters on the Batéké Plateau. Rapids interrupt navigation between Lastoursville and Ndjolé before the river turns west toward the Gulf of Guinea. Its broad delta spreads through a landscape of islands and wetlands rich in bird life.
simp_chinese: 奥果韦河发源于巴泰凯高原，汇集加蓬大部分地区的水流。拉斯图尔维尔与恩乔莱之间的急流阻断航行，河道随后折向西方，流入几内亚湾。宽广的三角洲铺展为岛屿与湿地交错的景观，栖息着丰富的鸟类。

english: The country around Ohatchee in Alabama was used by Andrew Jackson while preparing for the Battle of Talladega. Nearby Tallushatchee became a battlefield in November 1813, long before the modern town was incorporated in 1956.
simp_chinese: 阿拉巴马的奥哈奇周边，曾被安德鲁·杰克逊用于准备塔拉迪加战役。附近的塔卢沙奇于1813年11月成为战场，远早于1956年现代城镇正式设立。

english: Lake Ōhau lies in New Zealand’s Mackenzie Basin between the Barrier and Ben Ohau ranges. The Hopkins and Dobson rivers carry water from the Southern Alps into its northern end. The Ōhau River drains the lake toward the Waitaki system, linking this mountain basin with the country below.
simp_chinese: 奥豪湖位于新西兰麦肯齐盆地，介于巴里尔山脉与本奥豪山脉之间。霍普金斯河和多布森河将南阿尔卑斯山的流水带入湖北端。奥豪河再将湖水排向怀塔基水系，把山间湖盆与下游土地联系起来。

english: Oheyandewa belongs to the Indiana country between the Great Lakes and the Ohio River. The Wabash marks much of the region’s western edge, while the Ohio bounds it to the south.
simp_chinese: 奥海扬德瓦属于五大湖与俄亥俄河之间的印第安纳地区。沃巴什河构成这一地区西界的大部，俄亥俄河则界定其南缘。

english: O’Higgins Forest belongs to the Kawésqar country of Chilean Patagonia. The wider homeland extends through islands and mainland shores northwest of the Strait of Magellan and south of the Gulf of Penas, carrying a language whose name means person or human being.
simp_chinese: 奥希金斯森林属于智利巴塔哥尼亚卡韦斯卡尔地区。更广阔的家园延伸于麦哲伦海峡西北、佩纳斯湾以南的岛屿与大陆海岸，其语言名称意为人或人类。

english: Ohktouna belongs to the High Plains, the dry western portion of the wider Great Plains. In this regional environment, semi-arid steppe and open rangeland prevail. Extended droughts and strong winds can produce dust storms, while the broader plains once supported immense bison herds.
simp_chinese: 奥克托纳属于高平原，即广义大平原较干旱的西部。在这一地区，半干旱草原与开阔牧野占据主要地位。持续干旱配合强风可能引发沙尘暴，而更广阔的平原曾供养庞大的野牛群。

english: Ohkay Owingeh is a Tewa pueblo north of Santa Fe. Its name means “place of the Strong People.” Spanish colonists called it San Juan Pueblo, a name that remained official from 1598 until the community restored its original name in 2005.
simp_chinese: 奥克维奥温格是圣菲以北的一处特瓦人普韦布洛聚落，名称意为“强者之地”。西班牙殖民者称其为圣胡安普韦布洛，这个名称自1598年沿用为正式名称，直到社区在2005年恢复原名。

english: Ohoi Ewur belongs to the Aru country of the Moluccas. The wider island world lies at a cultural and geographic intersection of Asia and Oceania, with ancient Melanesian settlement followed by Austronesian migration.
simp_chinese: 奥霍伊埃乌尔属于摩鹿加的阿鲁地区。更广的岛屿世界位于亚洲与大洋洲的文化地理交汇处，古老美拉尼西亚定居之后又有南岛人迁入。

english: Ohoopee takes its name from the nearby river in Georgia. A modern community developed around a post office established in 1875, and the settlement received a municipal charter in 1907.
simp_chinese: 奥胡皮的名称源自佐治亚附近的同名河流。现代社群围绕1875年建立的邮局发展，聚落于1907年获得市镇特许状。

english: Ohrdruf lies at the northern foot of the Thuringian Forest. Its origins are traditionally linked to Saint Boniface, who reportedly founded a monastery dedicated to Saint Michael here in the 720s.
simp_chinese: 奥尔德鲁夫位于图林根森林北麓。传统将其起源与圣卜尼法斯联系起来，据称他于八世纪二十年代在这里建立了献给圣米迦勒的修道院。

english: Öhringen is a town of the Hohenlohe country near Heilbronn. Its historic buildings include a Renaissance town hall and a collegiate church preserving fifteenth-century cedar carvings and numerous tomb monuments.
simp_chinese: 厄林根是海尔布隆附近霍恩洛厄地区的一座城镇。历史建筑包括文艺复兴时期市政厅，以及保存15世纪雪松木雕和众多墓葬纪念物的教堂。

english: Ohuira Bay forms part of the coastal waters around Topolobampo in northwestern Sinaloa. The neighboring port opens onto the Gulf of California, where an arid coastal climate meets warm seas and maritime routes across to the Baja California peninsula.
simp_chinese: 奥维拉湾构成锡那罗亚西北部托波洛班波周边沿岸水域的一部分。邻近港口面向加利福尼亚湾，干旱海岸与温暖海水相接，海上航线通往下加利福尼亚半岛。

english: The Oiampi, or Wayampi, belong to the riverine world of the eastern Amazon and the Guianas. Their language is part of the Tupi-Guarani family. Portuguese accounts from 1690 describe migration from the lower Xingu toward the Jari, followed by movement north along the Jari and Amapari rivers.
simp_chinese: 奥扬皮人又称瓦扬皮人，生活于亚马孙东部与圭亚那地区的河流世界。他们的语言属于图皮—瓜拉尼语族。1690年的葡萄牙记载描述了他们从欣古河下游向雅里河迁徙，随后又沿雅里河与阿马帕里河向北移动的过程。

english: Oymyakon lies along the Indigirka in the Yana–Oymyakon Highlands. Its continental setting produces extraordinary winter cold, making it one of the most severe environments in which a permanent settlement has endured.
simp_chinese: 奥伊米亚康位于亚纳—奥伊米亚康高地的因迪吉尔卡河畔。大陆性环境带来异常严寒的冬季，使这里成为拥有永久聚落的最严酷环境之一。

english: Oitylo is an old settlement on Greece's Mani Peninsula. Mentioned in the Iliad as Oetylus, it grew into an important town of Mani during the Middle Ages.
simp_chinese: 伊蒂洛是希腊马尼半岛上的古老聚落。《伊利亚特》以奥伊提罗斯之名称其地，它在中世纪发展为马尼的重要城镇。

english: Oi-yin Körken belongs to the eastern Gobi country of southern Mongolia. The Gobi forms the southern desert margin of a wider plateau whose northern and western parts rise into mountains.
simp_chinese: 奥云科尔肯属于蒙古南部的东戈壁地区。戈壁构成更广高原的南部沙漠边缘，高原北部和西部则升为山地。

english: Ojos del Salado rises on the Argentina–Chile border in the Andes to about 6,893 metres. The volcanic complex has overlapping lava domes, craters and flows; extreme dryness limits its ice cover despite the great elevation.
simp_chinese: 奥霍斯-德尔萨拉多山位于阿根廷与智利边界的安第斯山脉，海拔约六千八百九十三米。火山复合体由重叠的熔岩穹丘、火山口与熔岩流组成，尽管海拔极高，极度干旱仍限制了冰层覆盖。

english: Ōkahu Bay belongs to New Zealand’s southwestern Pacific island waters. The wider archipelago includes two main islands and many smaller ones, with mountains and volcanic landscapes shaped by tectonic activity.
simp_chinese: 奥卡胡湾属于西南太平洋的新西兰群岛水域。整个群岛包括两座主岛及众多小岛，山地和火山景观受到构造活动塑造。

english: Okaisipi lies in the wider Outaouais country on the northern side of the Ottawa River. Before European settlement, Indigenous peoples used the river country as a place for trade and gatherings; the regional name ultimately derives from the Odawa.
simp_chinese: 奥凯西比位于渥太华河北岸的乌塔韦地区。欧洲移民到来以前，原住民族已将沿河地带用作交易和聚会之所；这一地区的名称最终源于奥达瓦人。

english: Okak was established on the Labrador coast in 1776 by Moravian missionary Jens Haven. The mission also served as a trading post for Inuit communities; a devastating influenza outbreak in 1918 later destroyed much of the settlement.
simp_chinese: 奥卡克由摩拉维亚教会传教士延斯·哈文于1776年建立在拉布拉多海岸。传教站也为因纽特社群提供贸易场所，1918年毁灭性的流感暴发后来重创了聚落。

english: Okak faces the Labrador Sea along northeastern Canada. The basin opens toward Greenland, with continental shelves along its margins.
simp_chinese: 奥卡克湾在加拿大东北面向拉布拉多海。海盆向格陵兰展开，边缘分布着大陆架。

english: Okam belongs to the Sea of Okhotsk’s continental coastal country. Across this wider coast, numerous capes and peninsulas separate gulfs and bays, while the sea also borders Kamchatka, the Kurils, Hokkaido and Sakhalin.
simp_chinese: 奥卡姆位于鄂霍次克海大陆沿岸地区。在这片广阔海岸，众多岬角与半岛将海湾相互分隔；鄂霍次克海还连接堪察加、千岛群岛、北海道及萨哈林岛沿岸。

english: The Okam Range belongs to the eastern Siberian mainland bordering the Sea of Okhotsk. This is one part of a much larger coastal world, whose shores also encompass Kamchatka, Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands. Mainland headlands and deep bays give the sea its complicated outline.
simp_chinese: 奥卡姆山脉属于鄂霍次克海边缘的西伯利亚东部大陆地域。它是广大环海地域的一部分，后者还包括堪察加、萨哈林与千岛群岛沿岸。大陆岬角与深海湾共同塑造了这片海域曲折的轮廓。

english: The Okanagan country follows the basin of Okanagan Lake and its river in British Columbia. Its dry landscapes and linked waters extend southward into the Okanogan country of Washington.
simp_chinese: 奥卡纳根地区沿不列颠哥伦比亚的奥卡纳根湖与同名河流流域展开。干燥的地貌与相连的水域向南延续到华盛顿的奥卡诺根地区。

english: Okanja belongs to the upper Ogooué country of Gabon. The wider Central African region contains ancient traces of human occupation extending more than a hundred thousand years into the past.
simp_chinese: 奥坎贾属于加蓬的上奥果韦地区。更广阔的中非区域保留着十多万年前人类活动的古老遗迹。

english: Ōkārito stands at the mouth of its river beside a lagoon on New Zealand's western South Island coast. Māori occupation and seasonal harvesting began more than six centuries ago, and one explanation of its name recalls edible young bulrush shoots.
simp_chinese: 奥卡里托位于新西兰南岛西海岸同名河流的河口，紧邻潟湖。毛利人在此居住和进行季节性采集已有六百多年，其地名的一种解释便与可食用的幼嫩香蒲芽有关。

english: The Okavango, called Cubango in Angola, begins in the country’s sandy highlands and flows southeast. Its wider river system passes through Namibia towards Botswana, where it ends in an inland delta rather than reaching the sea; the Cuito is a major tributary.
simp_chinese: 奥卡万戈河在安哥拉称库邦戈河，发源于该国沙质高地，向东南流去。整个河流系统经过纳米比亚通向博茨瓦纳，最终止于内陆三角洲而不入海；奎托河是其重要支流。

english: Okaw belongs to the wider Illinois cultural country associated with the Moingona. These Miami-Illinois people were closely allied with the Peoria and lost their separate identity through assimilation around 1700. Seventeenth-century French accounts placed them among Illinois-speaking communities living near one another on the prairie.
simp_chinese: 奥卡乌属于与莫因戈纳人相关的广义伊利诺伊文化地区。这支迈阿密—伊利诺伊人与皮奥里亚人关系密切，约1700年在融合中失去独立身份。17世纪法国记载将其列为草原上相邻居住的伊利诺伊语社群之一。

english: Oke Ila was the capital of an Igbomina-Yoruba city-state in northeastern Yorubaland. Ridges and gorges of quartzite separate it from its sister city and kingdom, Ila Orangun, roughly twelve kilometres away.
simp_chinese: 奥凯伊拉曾是约鲁巴地区东北部一个伊格博米纳—约鲁巴城邦的首都。石英岩山脊与峡谷将它同约十二公里外的姐妹城市及王国伊拉奥朗贡分隔开来。

english: Okeechobee belongs to the lake country of southern Florida. When written records begin in the sixteenth century, the Mayaimi inhabited the Lake Okeechobee area, among the several distinct peoples occupying the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 奥基乔比属于佛罗里达南部的湖区。十六世纪文字记录开始出现时，马亚伊米人居住于奥基乔比湖一带，是半岛上多个不同族群之一。

english: Okehampton stands on the northern edge of Dartmoor, its name recalling a settlement on the River Okement. Recorded in the tenth century, it later grew through the medieval wool trade. After the Norman conquest Baldwin FitzGilbert established its castle, which became the centre of a substantial feudal barony. The Courtenay family rebuilt the stronghold, but its fortunes changed when Henry VIII seized the estates and executed Henry Courtenay in 1539. The castle, the fifteenth-century chapel of St James and the old town together recall the traffic of wool, lordship and royal power at the moor's edge.
simp_chinese: 奥克汉普顿位于达特穆尔北缘，名称让人想起奥克门特河畔的聚落。这里在10世纪已有记载，后来依靠中世纪羊毛贸易发展。诺曼征服之后，鲍德温·菲茨吉尔伯特建立城堡，使其成为一处大型封建领地的中心。考特尼家族重建了堡垒，但1539年亨利八世没收地产并处死亨利·考特尼后，它的命运随之改变。城堡、15世纪的圣詹姆斯礼拜堂与老城，一同留下荒原边缘羊毛流通、领主权力和王权交织的记忆。

english: Okeloussa belongs to the wider Mississippi region in southeastern North America. In the Mississippi Delta, Indigenous settlements and fields developed along natural levees, where higher ground stood close to the river.
simp_chinese: 俄克卢萨属于北美洲东南部广义的密西西比地区。在密西西比三角洲，原住民的聚落和农田沿天然堤岸发展，那里是靠近河流的较高地带。

english: Okhaldhunga serves as the centre of its namesake district in eastern Nepal. Its settlement combines administrative functions with local cultural life. In modern times, community radio stations have broadcast local programmes under the names Radio Likhu and Ramailo Samudayek Radio.
simp_chinese: 奥卡尔东加是尼泊尔东部同名地区的中心，聚落兼具行政职能与地方文化生活。现代当地设有利库广播电台和拉迈洛社区电台，以社区节目服务居民。

english: Okhannoye stands on the right bank of the Kama, southwest of Perm. First recorded as a village in 1597, it also bore the names Okhanskoye and Okhan. It received town status in 1781 as Okhansk, and later became a place of exile for Polish insurgents.
simp_chinese: 奥汉诺耶位于彼尔姆西南、卡马河右岸。1597年首次以村落身份见于记载，也曾称奥汉斯科耶或奥汉。1781年以奥汉斯克之名获城镇地位，后来成为波兰起义者的流放地。

english: Okhona belongs to the wider northern country associated with Novgorod Land. This historical realm linked northern Rus' with the White Sea and maintained extensive Hanseatic trade; the republic’s conquest by Moscow in 1478 marked a decisive change in the region’s political history.
simp_chinese: 奥霍纳属于与诺夫哥罗德地相联系的广大北方地区。这一历史政体把罗斯北部与白海相连，并与汉萨贸易网络密切往来；1478年共和国被莫斯科征服，是地区政治史的重要转折。

english: These waters belong to northern Kamchatka’s Olyutor coastal region. Olyutor Bay opens into the Bering Sea between the Govena and Olyutor peninsulas and is normally icebound through much of winter and spring.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于堪察加北部的奥柳托尔沿海地区。奥柳托尔湾在戈韦纳与奥柳托尔半岛之间通向白令海，冬春大部分时间通常封冻。

english: This coastal sector lies around Olyutor Bay in the Bering Sea. Govena and Olyutor peninsulas enclose the gulf, whose shores are normally icebound from December to May.
simp_chinese: 这片沿岸海区位于白令海的奥柳托尔湾周围。戈韦纳与奥柳托尔两半岛围合海湾，其岸边通常从十二月至五月封冻。

english: The Okhotsk coast borders a sea enclosed by Sakhalin, Hokkaido, the Kurils and Kamchatka. Its name comes from the port of Okhotsk and ultimately the Okhota River.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海岸邻接萨哈林、北海道、千岛与堪察加环绕的海域。海名来自鄂霍次克港，最终源自鄂霍塔河。

english: These coastal waters form part of the Sea of Okhotsk, bordered by eastern Siberia, Kamchatka, the Kuril Islands, Hokkaido and Sakhalin. Winter sea ice obstructs navigation, while cold, nutrient-bearing waters sustain abundant marine life.
simp_chinese: 这片沿岸水域属于鄂霍次克海，周围是东西伯利亚、堪察加半岛、千岛群岛、北海道和萨哈林岛。冬季海冰妨碍航行，寒冷而富含养分的海水则支持着丰富的海洋生物。

english: These coastal waters belong to the Sea of Okhotsk. Kamchatka, the Kurils, Hokkaido and Sakhalin enclose much of the basin around its Siberian shore.
simp_chinese: 这片沿岸水域属于鄂霍次克海。堪察加、千岛群岛、北海道与萨哈林，将西伯利亚海岸周围的大部分海盆围合。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk is enclosed by Siberia, Sakhalin, the Kurils and Kamchatka. In winter drifting ice hinders navigation, while connections on both sides of Sakhalin lead towards the Sea of Japan.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海被西伯利亚、萨哈林、千岛与堪察加环抱。冬季浮冰妨碍航行，萨哈林两侧水道则通往日本海。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk lies between Siberia, Kamchatka, Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands. Its name comes from the port of Okhotsk and ultimately from the Okhota River.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海位于西伯利亚、堪察加、库页岛与千岛群岛之间。海名来自鄂霍次克港，更早则源于鄂霍塔河。

english: These waters form part of the Sea of Okhotsk in the northwestern Pacific. Kamchatka bounds the sea to the east, while Sakhalin and the Siberian mainland form its western margins.
simp_chinese: 这片海水属于西北太平洋的鄂霍次克海。堪察加半岛位于东面，库页岛与西伯利亚大陆则构成西部边缘。

english: This stretch of coast faces the Sea of Okhotsk in the northwestern Pacific. Kamchatka bounds the sea to the east, while Sakhalin and the Siberian mainland enclose its western side.
simp_chinese: 这段海岸面向西北太平洋的鄂霍次克海。堪察加半岛位于该海东侧，库页岛与西伯利亚大陆环抱其西侧。

english: Kamchatka stands between the Sea of Okhotsk and the Bering-Pacific waters. Its volcanic ranges form part of the Ring of Fire, with the deep Kuril-Kamchatka Trench lying offshore.
simp_chinese: 堪察加介于鄂霍次克海与白令海、太平洋水域之间。火山山地属于环太平洋火山带，深邃的千岛—堪察加海沟位于近海。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk lies between eastern Siberia, Sakhalin, Hokkaido and Kamchatka. Winter ice floes have long restricted navigation across its waters.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海位于东西伯利亚、萨哈林岛、北海道和堪察加之间。冬季浮冰长期限制着这片海域的航行。

english: These coastal waters belong to the Sea of Okhotsk, enclosed by eastern Siberia, Kamchatka, the Kurils and Sakhalin. Across the wider sea, winter ice restricts navigation. Fresh water from the Amur lowers the surface salinity and helps ice form, linking conditions offshore with a distant continental river basin.
simp_chinese: 这片沿岸水域属于由东西伯利亚、堪察加、千岛群岛和库页岛环抱的鄂霍次克海。就整个海域而言，冬季浮冰限制航行。黑龙江淡水降低了表层盐度，有助于海冰形成，使近海环境与遥远的大陆流域相联系。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk is enclosed by Kamchatka, the Kurils, Hokkaido, Sakhalin and the Siberian coast. Winter ice makes navigation difficult, and the sea takes its name from the port of Okhotsk and the Okhota River.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海由堪察加、千岛群岛、北海道、萨哈林及西伯利亚海岸环抱。冬季浮冰妨碍航行，海名源自鄂霍次克港及鄂霍塔河。

english: These coastal waters belong to the Sea of Okhotsk in the northwestern Pacific. Kamchatka, Sakhalin, the Kurils and the Siberian coast frame the sea, where winter ice can impede navigation.
simp_chinese: 这片近岸水域属于西北太平洋鄂霍次克海。堪察加、萨哈林、千岛群岛与西伯利亚海岸环列周边，冬季海冰可能妨碍航行。

english: The Amur coast lies within the wider historical region of Manchuria in Northeast Asia. In its broader geographical sense, Manchuria includes the Amur basin and parts of the Russian Far East ceded by the Qing dynasty in 1858–1860.
simp_chinese: 黑龙江沿岸属于东北亚广义的历史满洲地区。按较广的地理定义，满洲包括黑龙江流域，以及清朝在1858至1860年间割让给俄罗斯的部分远东地区。

english: The Alyutor coastal region lies in northeastern Kamchatka. Its wider district contains major rivers including the Pakhacha and Apuka, whose headwaters lie near those of the north-flowing Mayn.
simp_chinese: 阿柳托尔沿海地区位于堪察加东北部。周边地区有帕哈恰河与阿普卡河等主要河流，其源头靠近向北流动的迈因河源区。

english: Olyutor Bay opens onto the Bering Sea between the Govena and Olyutor peninsulas. Its steep western shore is backed by the Pylgin Range, and the bay is normally icebound from December to May.
simp_chinese: 奥柳托尔湾在戈韦纳半岛与奥柳托尔半岛之间通向白令海。湾西岸陡峭，背靠皮尔金山脉，海湾通常从12月至次年5月封冻。

english: These Okhotsk waters lie off the northeastern Asian mainland near the outer Manchurian region. In its broader historical sense, Manchuria included the Amur basin and parts of the Russian Far East, beyond today's northeastern China.
simp_chinese: 这片鄂霍次克水域位于亚洲东北大陆外海，邻近外满洲地区。广义历史上的满洲除今天中国东北外，还包括阿穆尔河流域及俄罗斯远东部分地区。

english: These Okhotsk waters face the northeastern Asian region historically associated with Manchuria and the lower Amur. Parts of that river basin passed from Qing rule to the Russian Empire in 1858–1860, becoming known collectively as Outer Manchuria.
simp_chinese: 这片鄂霍次克海水域面向历史上与满洲及黑龙江下游相联系的东北亚地区。1858至1860年间，黑龙江流域的部分土地由清朝转入俄罗斯帝国统治，后来统称外满洲。

english: These Okhotsk waters border the northeastern Asian region historically associated with Outer Manchuria. In its broader geographical sense, Manchuria includes the Amur basin and parts of the Russian Far East.
simp_chinese: 这片鄂霍次克海水域邻接历史上与外满洲相关的东北亚地区。广义上的满洲包括黑龙江流域及俄罗斯远东的部分地区。

english: These northern Pacific waters border the Kuril island region. Historical Japanese usage placed the Kurils within the broad northern lands known as Ezo, together with Hokkaido and Sakhalin.
simp_chinese: 这片北太平洋水域毗邻千岛群岛地区。在历史日本用语中，千岛群岛与北海道、萨哈林一同被纳入广义的北方虾夷地区。

english: These waters lie off the volcanic Kamchatka Peninsula. The peninsula separates the Sea of Okhotsk on its western side from Pacific and Bering waters to the east, and its volcanoes form part of the Ring of Fire.
simp_chinese: 这片水域位于火山众多的堪察加半岛外侧。半岛将西面的鄂霍次克海与东部太平洋、白令海水域分隔，其火山是环太平洋火山带的一部分。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk lies between Siberia, Sakhalin, Kamchatka and the Kurils. Hokkaido forms part of its southern boundary.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海位于西伯利亚、萨哈林、堪察加与千岛群岛之间。北海道构成其南部边界的一部分。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk is enclosed by Siberia, Kamchatka, the Kurils and Sakhalin. Its channels around Sakhalin connect southward with the Sea of Japan, while broad northern bays reach toward the mainland.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海由西伯利亚、堪察加、千岛与萨哈林围合。萨哈林两侧水道向南连接日本海，北部宽阔海湾则伸向大陆。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk lies between Kamchatka, the Kurils, Sakhalin and Siberia. Its name comes from the port of Okhotsk and ultimately the Okhota River.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海位于堪察加、千岛群岛、库页岛与西伯利亚之间。海名源自鄂霍次克港，并最终追溯至鄂霍塔河。

english: These waters belong to the Sea of Okhotsk between Kamchatka, Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands. Winter ice floes impede navigation across much of the sea.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于堪察加、萨哈林岛与千岛群岛之间的鄂霍次克海。冬季浮冰阻碍大片海面的航行。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk is enclosed by Kamchatka, the Kurils, Hokkaido and the northeastern Asian mainland. Its name comes from the port of Okhotsk and ultimately the Okhota River.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海被堪察加、千岛群岛、北海道及东北亚大陆环抱。海名来自鄂霍次克港，最终源于鄂霍塔河。

english: The Kuril Islands belong to the northern maritime world historically described in Japan as Ezo. By 1485 this designation was used for northern islands including Hokkaido, Sakhalin and the Kurils, whose inhabitants were associated with the ancestors of today’s Ainu.
simp_chinese: 千岛群岛属于日本历史上称为“虾夷”的北方海洋世界。到1485年，这个称呼已用于北海道、库页岛和千岛群岛等北方岛屿，其居民与今天阿伊努人的祖先有关。

english: These northern island waters lie in the broader Ezo region around Hokkaido and the Kurils. The historical name Ezo also encompassed Sakhalin and was associated with northern peoples including the Ainu.
simp_chinese: 这片北方岛屿水域位于北海道与千岛群岛周边的广义虾夷地区。历史名称虾夷也涵盖萨哈林岛，并与阿伊努等北方民族相关。

english: These waters lie beside the Kuril island chain between the Pacific and the Okhotsk maritime world. Early Japanese geographical usage could include the Kurils within Ezo, a term also applied to Hokkaido and sometimes Sakhalin.
simp_chinese: 这片水域位于太平洋与鄂霍次克海洋世界之间的千岛群岛旁。早期日本的地理用语有时将千岛群岛纳入虾夷范围，这一名称也用于北海道，有时还包括萨哈林岛。

english: The continental shores of the Sea of Okhotsk meet the wider northeastern Asian region historically associated with Manchuria. Broad definitions of that region include the Amur basin and parts of the Russian Far East.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海的大陆沿岸与历史上同满洲相关的东北亚地区相接。广义的这一地区包括黑龙江流域及俄罗斯远东的部分地区。

english: The Sea of Okhotsk is enclosed by Kamchatka, the Kuril Islands, Hokkaido, Sakhalin and the Siberian mainland. It takes its name from the port of Okhotsk and the Okhota River. Fresh water carried by the Amur lowers surface salinity, helping winter ice form and complicating navigation.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海被堪察加半岛、千岛群岛、北海道、萨哈林岛与西伯利亚大陆围绕。海域名称来自鄂霍次克港及鄂霍塔河。阿穆尔河输入的淡水降低表层盐度，促进冬季结冰，也使航行更加困难。

english: Okhtyrka stands beside its namesake river in Sloboda Ukraine, between Sumy, Kharkiv and Poltava. The town’s past is closely associated with Cossacks and hussars, and it served as a regional administrative seat. Its religious buildings preserve another strand of this military and frontier history.
simp_chinese: 奥赫蒂尔卡坐落在斯洛博达乌克兰的同名河畔，处在苏梅、哈尔科夫与波尔塔瓦之间。城镇历史与哥萨克和骠骑兵紧密相连，也曾作为地区行政中心。当地宗教建筑保留着这段军事与边疆历史的另一面。

english: Oki belongs to the northern maritime world of western Japan. It was associated with the San’indō circuit, whose name distinguishes the shaded side of Honshu’s mountains from the sunny San’yō side.
simp_chinese: 隐岐属于日本西部的北方海域。它与山阴道相联系，该名称将本州山脉背阴的一侧与向阳的山阳一侧区分开来。

english: Okladnikova sloboda belongs to the Mezen country of the White Sea north. The regional town lies close to the mouth of the Mezen River, where the river landscape meets the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 奥克拉德尼科瓦镇属于白海南部的梅津地区。区域城镇位于梅津河口附近，河流景观在此与北方海岸相接。

english: The Oklan flows from the Koryak Highlands into the Penzhina, crossing a marshy floodplain with many small lakes. Its Koryak name means icy way. Russian Cossacks reached the basin in the seventeenth century and built Aklansk fort, while local Koryaks practised reindeer herding and fishing.
simp_chinese: 奥克兰河从科里亚克高地流入品仁纳河，穿过遍布小湖的沼泽洪泛平原。科里亚克语河名意为“冰路”。俄罗斯哥萨克于十七世纪抵达流域并修建阿克兰斯克堡，当地科里亚克人则以驯鹿放牧和捕鱼为生。

english: Okobojo takes its name from a Dakota expression meaning to plant in spaces. The later town in South Dakota was laid out in 1883 and developed stores, a school and a newspaper before becoming a ghost town.
simp_chinese: 奥科博霍得名于达科他语中表示间隔种植的说法。后来南达科他的同名城镇于1883年规划建镇，发展出商店、学校和报纸，最终成为废弃城镇。

english: Okoneshnikovo is a settlement in the Omsk region of western Siberia. Its modern urban-type community counted just over five thousand inhabitants in the 2010 census.
simp_chinese: 奥科涅什尼科沃是西西伯利亚鄂木斯克地区的一处聚落。2010年人口普查记载，这处现代城镇型社群有五千余名居民。

english: Okotoks lies on the Sheep River in what is now Alberta. Its Blackfoot name means rock, recalling the great glacial boulder used by travelers of the Blackfoot Confederacy as a landmark for finding the river crossing.
simp_chinese: 奥科托克斯位于今艾伯塔的希普河畔。其黑脚语地名意为岩石，使人想起当地巨大的冰川漂砾；黑脚联盟的旅行者曾以它为地标寻找渡河处。

english: Oksu belongs to the Badakhshan and Pamir borderlands of the broader Khorasan world. The historical name Khorasan had shifting boundaries and, in its wider usage, extended eastwards towards the Pamir Mountains and the lands around the Oxus.
simp_chinese: 奥克苏属于更广阔呼罗珊世界的巴达赫尚与帕米尔边地。呼罗珊这一历史名称的边界不断变化，广义上曾向东延伸至帕米尔山地及阿姆河周围地区。

english: Oktahutchee belongs to the Central Great Plains, a broad grassland region with few trees. The mixed-grass belt stretches from Nebraska and Kansas through Oklahoma toward northern Texas.
simp_chinese: 奥克塔胡奇属于大平原中部，这是一片树木稀少的广阔草原。混合草原带从内布拉斯加与堪萨斯，经俄克拉何马延伸至得克萨斯北部。

english: Oktyabr’skii belongs to the Kamchatka peninsula country. The wider region is bounded by the Sea of Okhotsk on the west and Pacific waters on the east, with volcanic mountain chains forming part of the Ring of Fire.
simp_chinese: 十月镇属于堪察加半岛地区。更广阔的区域西临鄂霍次克海、东接太平洋海域，火山山链构成环太平洋火山带的一部分。

english: This is part of Kamchatka’s coastal world in the Russian Far East. The long peninsula separates the Sea of Okhotsk to the west from the Bering Sea and Pacific to the east.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于俄罗斯远东堪察加半岛的沿海地区。狭长半岛将西侧的鄂霍次克海与东侧的白令海及太平洋分开。

english: The Okuchichibu Mountains form an interior highland between the Kantō and Kōshin’etsu regions of Japan. Folded ridges rise from roughly one thousand to twenty-six hundred metres, spreading across the borders of several provinces and modern prefectures.
simp_chinese: 奥秩父山地构成日本关东与甲信越之间的内陆高地。褶皱山脊从约一千米升至两千六百米，横跨多个历史令制国及现代县界。

english: The Okwanuchu homeland lay around the southern approaches to Mount Shasta in northern California. It included parts of the upper Sacramento and McCloud rivers. Their language was closely related to Shasta, while archaeological sites within their wider territory reveal human occupation reaching back more than five millennia.
simp_chinese: 奥夸努楚人的故土位于加利福尼亚北部沙斯塔山南侧，包括萨克拉门托河与麦克劳德河的部分上游地区。其语言与沙斯塔语关系密切，更广阔领地内的考古遗址显示，人类活动可追溯至五千多年前。

english: The Ol’de trail belongs to the northern reaches of the wider eastern Siberian landscape. Tundra forms the northern part of this vast region, whose inland areas are largely occupied by the Central Siberian Plateau.
simp_chinese: 奥尔杰小径属于更广阔东西伯利亚地域的北部。苔原构成这片辽阔区域的北缘，内陆大部分则为中西伯利亚高原。

english: Oladjau belongs to the Mangarla country of northwestern Australia. The wider people traditionally occupied the northwestern Great Sandy Desert, and their language belongs to the Marrngu branch of the Pama–Nyungan family, with distinct Kakutu and Ngulatu varieties.
simp_chinese: 奥拉焦属于澳大利亚西北部的曼加拉地区。范围更大的曼加拉人传统上生活于大沙沙漠西北部，语言属于帕马—恩永甘语系的马尔恩古分支，有卡库图与恩古拉图等不同变体。

english: Olan belongs to the Chachapoyas mountain country around Kuélap. The wider region contains cloud forests and limestone ridges, where Kuélap’s great walled settlement overlooked the Utcubamba Valley.
simp_chinese: 奥兰属于库埃拉普周边的查查波亚斯山地。更广阔的地区分布云雾林与石灰岩山脊，库埃拉普的大型围墙聚落俯瞰乌特库班巴河谷。

english: Olanchito was founded in 1530 in the country of Yoro, Honduras. Agriculture became its principal industry, while its cultural history includes the novelist Ramón Amaya Amador, whose manuscripts and books were preserved in his home town.
simp_chinese: 奥兰奇托于1530年建立于洪都拉斯约罗地区。农业成为主要产业，当地文化史还包括小说家拉蒙·阿马亚·阿马多尔，他的手稿与藏书保存在故乡。

english: Öland lies in the Baltic opposite the coast of Småland, separated from the mainland by the Kalmar Strait. Much of the island is farmland, its fertile plains benefiting from comparatively mild and sunny summers.
simp_chinese: 厄兰岛位于斯莫兰海岸对面的波罗的海，以卡尔马海峡与大陆相隔。岛上大片土地用于农业，肥沃平原受益于相对温和而晴朗的夏季。

english: Öland's offshore waters belong to the Baltic Proper. This brackish shelf sea exchanges water with the Atlantic only through the narrow Danish straits, giving its island coasts a distinctive marine setting.
simp_chinese: 厄兰岸外水域属于波罗的海主体。这片半咸水陆架海仅经狭窄丹麦海峡与大西洋交换，使岛岸具有独特海洋环境。

english: Ólafsvík belongs to western Iceland. The wider island stands on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, with volcanic plateaus, glaciers and rivers descending through lowlands to the sea.
simp_chinese: 奥拉夫斯维克属于冰岛西部。更广阔的冰岛位于大西洋中脊，拥有火山高原与冰川，河流穿过低地汇入海洋。

english: Oława grew between the Oder and Oława rivers in Lower Silesia. A river crossing, surrounding forests and waters encouraged the development of a market and stronghold. The settlement appears in a papal document of 1201 under the Latinized name Oleva.
simp_chinese: 奥瓦瓦在下西里西亚的奥得河与奥瓦瓦河之间发展。渡口以及周围森林和水域促成了市场与堡寨的形成。1201年的教皇文书以拉丁化名称奥莱瓦记载此地。

english: Old Wives Lake is a shallow, closed salt lake in southern Saskatchewan, fed by the Wood River. Seasonal changes expose broad mudflats, and its waters and islands support migratory birds; a bird sanctuary was established here in 1925.
simp_chinese: 老妻湖是萨斯喀彻温南部一座浅水内流盐湖，由伍德河补给。季节变化使大片泥滩露出水面，湖水与岛屿为候鸟提供栖息地；这里于1925年设立了鸟类保护区。

english: Oldenburg stands on the Hunte and Haaren in northwestern Germany. First documented as Aldenburg in 1108, it became the place of origin and residence of the House of Oldenburg.
simp_chinese: 奥尔登堡位于德国西北部的亨特河与哈伦河畔。它于1108年以Aldenburg之名首次见于文献，后来成为奥尔登堡家族的发源地和驻地。

english: Oldenzaal lies in Twente, in the eastern part of Overijssel close to the German border. It received city rights in 1249, giving formal expression to its place among the urban communities of the region. The town also participated in the Hanseatic network as a subsidiary of Deventer, linking a comparatively small inland settlement with a much wider system of merchants and trading cities. Its history illustrates how urban privileges and commercial affiliation could give a borderland town connections extending well beyond its immediate countryside.
simp_chinese: 奥尔登扎尔位于上艾瑟尔东部的特文特地区，靠近德意志边境。它于1249年获得城市权利，正式确立了在地区城镇群体中的地位。城镇还作为代芬特尔的附属城市参与汉萨网络，将一处规模较小的内陆聚落与范围广大的商人和贸易城市体系连接起来。它的历史展现出城市特权与商业联系，如何让一座边境城镇建立远超周边乡村范围的关系。

english: The Olyokma is a tributary of the Lena in eastern Siberia. In the seventeenth century, Russian explorers used its valley as part of the route toward the Amur.
simp_chinese: 奥廖克马河是东西伯利亚勒拿河的一条支流。十七世纪，俄罗斯探险者曾沿其谷地踏上通往阿穆尔河的路线。

english: Oleksandrivka belongs to the wider Bakhmut country of eastern Ukraine. The regional center of Bakhmut grew from a frontier post and later served as the capital of Slavo-Serbia, a colony established for settlers from the Balkans.
simp_chinese: 奥列克桑德里夫卡属于乌克兰东部更广阔的巴赫穆特地区。地区中心巴赫穆特由边境哨所发展起来，后来曾是斯拉夫塞尔维亚的首府，该殖民区为巴尔干移民而设。

english: Olenda belongs to the landscape of the Nyanga basin in southern Gabon. The Nyanga rises near the Congolese border and winds through rapids before crossing the coastal plain to the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 奥伦达处于加蓬南部尼扬加河流域的地理背景之中。尼扬加河发源于刚果边境附近，曲折流经急流河段，再穿过沿海平原注入大西洋。

english: Olenegorsk belongs to the Yandin country of eastern Siberia. On a regional scale, this Siberian world extends across Yakutia and neighbouring lands, with northern tundra contrasting with southern mountain ranges.
simp_chinese: 奥列涅戈尔斯克属于东西伯利亚的扬丁地区。在区域尺度上，这片西伯利亚地区涵盖雅库特和邻近土地，北方苔原与南部山脉各具特色。

english: Olenitsa is a small settlement on the Kola Peninsula. It belongs to the Tersky district and stands only about six metres above sea level, placing it within the peninsula's low coastal country.
simp_chinese: 奥列尼察是科拉半岛的一处小聚落，属于捷尔斯基地区。这里海拔仅约六米，位于半岛低平的沿海地带。

english: The Olentangy is a tributary of the Scioto River in Ohio. Its earlier Delaware name referred to sharp tools, reflecting the shale along its banks, before a nineteenth-century naming error gave it the name of another stream.
simp_chinese: 奥伦坦吉河是俄亥俄州赛奥托河的一条支流。早先的特拉华语名称意指锐利工具，与岸边页岩有关，十九世纪的一次命名错误使它采用了原属另一条河流的名称。

english: Ölöön belongs to the lower Lena country of Yakutia. Yakutia forms part of Eastern Siberia, a region whose northern landscapes are dominated by tundra.
simp_chinese: 厄列尼奥克属于雅库特的下勒拿地区。雅库特是东西伯利亚的一部分，这一广大区域的北部景观以冻原为主。

english: Oléron lies off France's Atlantic coast beside the Pertuis d'Antioche strait. Pliny the Elder recorded the island as Uliaros in the first century. Vine growing became a lasting part of its economy, although the nineteenth-century phylloxera epidemic devastated its vineyards.
simp_chinese: 奥莱龙岛位于法国大西洋岸外、安蒂奥什海峡旁。老普林尼在一世纪将其记为乌利亚罗斯。葡萄种植长期是岛上经济的一部分，但十九世纪的根瘤蚜灾害摧毁了大片葡萄园。

english: Oleshia was a port settlement on the lower Dnieper under the authority of Kievan Rus’. Fishing and trade flourished along the route linking the Varangians with the Greeks, although the settlement’s exact site remains disputed.
simp_chinese: 奥列西亚曾是第聂伯河下游一处受基辅罗斯控制的港口聚落。它沿瓦良格人通往希腊人的商路发展渔业与贸易，但聚落的确切位置仍有争论。

english: Oleśnica developed around a Piast castle and trading settlement recorded in 1189. It received town privileges in 1255 and became the capital of its own Silesian principality in 1313. Its sixteenth-century ducal castle and early modern printing traditions preserve the legacy of a small but enduring courtly centre.
simp_chinese: 奥莱希尼察围绕皮雅斯特家族城堡与贸易聚落发展起来，1189年的文献已提及此地。它于1255年获得城市特权，1313年成为同名西里西亚公国的首府。十六世纪公爵城堡与近代早期的印刷传统，保留了这座小型宫廷中心的历史。

english: Olesno grew near the ancient Amber Road in Piast Silesia. It received town rights in 1275 and possessed a mint. The town remained under local Polish dukes after the Duchy of Opole became a Bohemian fief in 1327, illustrating the layered allegiances of the region.
simp_chinese: 奥莱斯诺在皮亚斯特王朝统治的西里西亚、古老琥珀之路附近发展起来。1275年这里取得城市权，并设有铸币厂。1327年奥波莱公国成为波希米亚封地后，城镇仍由当地波兰公爵统治，体现了地区层叠的政治归属。

english: Olevsk lies in the wooded country of Zhytomyr Polissya. First mentioned in 1488, the settlement received Magdeburg rights from King Władysław IV in 1641 before later passing into the Russian Empire.
simp_chinese: 奥列夫斯克位于日托米尔波利西亚的林地之中。聚落于1488年首次见于记载，1641年获瓦迪斯瓦夫四世授予马格德堡城市法，后来归入俄罗斯帝国。

english: Olga Bay lies on the Primorye coast of the Sea of Japan. Its northern inlet, Tikhaya Pristan, is well sheltered from winds and waves. British and Russian sailors bestowed different names during visits in 1856 and 1857, with the Russian name honouring Saint Olga of Kiev.
simp_chinese: 奥尔加湾位于滨海地区的日本海岸。北部季哈亚普里斯坦湾口能有效避风浪。1856与1857年到访的英国和俄国水手分别赋予不同名称，俄语湾名纪念基辅的圣奥尔加。

english: Olgov belongs to the wider Kursk country on the southeastern approaches to medieval Rus. The regional centre of Kursk developed near the meeting of the Kur, Tuskar and Seym rivers and served as a princely stronghold.
simp_chinese: 奥尔戈夫属于中世纪罗斯东南通路上的广阔库尔斯克地区。区域中心库尔斯克在库尔河、图斯卡尔河与谢伊姆河交汇处附近发展，曾是诸王公的堡垒。

english: The Olguydakh rises from Lake Toymoku on the Vilyuy Plateau in Sakha. It crosses a sparsely inhabited, lake-studded landscape before joining the Alymdya to form the Akhtaranda.
simp_chinese: 奥尔古伊达赫河发源于萨哈维柳伊高原的托伊莫库湖。河流穿过人烟稀少、湖泊散布的地区，与阿雷姆贾河汇合后形成阿赫塔兰达河。

english: Olı Bäräzä lies north of Kazan in Tatarstan. The village already existed during the Kazan Khanate, and its inhabitants later belonged to the estate of state peasants under Russian rule.
simp_chinese: 大别列泽位于鞑靼斯坦喀山以北。村庄在喀山汗国时期已存在，居民后来在俄罗斯统治下属于国有农民阶层。

english: Olimisk lies in the Moose River country near western James Bay. The regional centre of Moosonee connects inland transport with the bay, while the older community of Moose Factory stands on a nearby river island.
simp_chinese: 奥利米斯克位于詹姆斯湾西部附近的穆斯河地区。地区中心穆索尼连接内陆交通与海湾，较早的穆斯工厂聚落则坐落在附近河岛上。

english: Olite, also called Erriberri, lies in central Navarre. A historical tradition links its predecessor Oligicus with the Visigothic king Swinthila. The later medieval town is distinguished by its Gothic royal palace, which served as the residence of Charles III of Navarre.
simp_chinese: 奥利特又称埃里贝里，位于纳瓦拉中部。一种历史传统将其前身奥利吉库斯与西哥特国王苏因提拉相联系。后来的中世纪城镇以哥特式王宫著称，这里曾是纳瓦拉国王查理三世的驻地。

english: Oliveira grew from a stopping place on the Path of Goiás in the Minas Gerais highlands. Travellers moving toward Goiás helped sustain the village, which had a chapel by 1758 and later gained regional political importance during the Brazilian Empire.
simp_chinese: 奥利维拉由米纳斯吉拉斯高地通往戈亚斯道路上的歇脚点发展而来。前往戈亚斯的旅人为村落带来生计，1758年这里已设有小教堂，巴西帝国时期又取得区域政治地位。

english: Ollalko belongs to the Pech country of northeastern Honduras. The Pech speak a Chibchan language and traditionally inhabited densely forested lands in Olancho, Colón and the Mosquito Coast hinterland.
simp_chinese: 奥拉尔科属于洪都拉斯东北部的佩契人地区。佩契人使用奇布查语，传统上居住于奥兰乔、科隆和莫斯基托海岸腹地的茂密森林中。

english: Ollelewa lies in Niger's Zinder region. It is a village and rural commune within Tanout Department.
simp_chinese: 奥莱莱瓦位于尼日尔津德尔地区。它是塔努特省境内的一座村庄和乡村公社。

english: Ollo belongs to the middle Amur country. The wider river links northeastern Asia's inland basins with the Pacific drainage and now forms a long international boundary. Its waters support taimen, pike, salmon and the enormous kaluga sturgeon, among the world's largest freshwater fish.
simp_chinese: 鄂罗属于黑龙江中游地区。更广阔的河流连接东北亚内陆盆地与太平洋水系，如今部分河段构成漫长国界。水中生活着哲罗鱼、狗鱼、鲑鱼，以及世界最大淡水鱼之一的巨型达氏鳇。

english: Olo belongs to the Torricelli-language country of northern New Guinea. The Olo language is spoken in villages around Aitape and inland Sandaun, with Payi and Wapi among its closely connected dialects.
simp_chinese: 奥洛属于新几内亚北部托里切利语系地区。奥洛语见于艾塔佩周围及桑道恩内陆的村落，派伊与瓦皮是其密切相连的方言。

english: Olofsborg was founded by Erik Axelsson Tott in 1475 on an island in the Kyrönsalmi strait between two Finnish lakes. Its stone towers asserted Swedish power in a contested borderland after the fall of Novgorod, and the fortress remains one of the best-preserved medieval castles of the Swedish realm.
simp_chinese: 奥洛夫堡由埃里克·阿克塞尔松·托特于1475年创建，坐落在芬兰两湖之间的屈伦萨尔米海峡小岛上。诺夫哥罗德覆亡后，它的石塔在争议边疆宣示瑞典的权力，城堡也成为瑞典旧疆保存最完好的中世纪堡垒之一。

english: Olohega, also known as Swains Island, is a remote coral atoll in the Tokelau island group. It has been administered with American Samoa since 1925, while its relationship with Tokelau remains disputed.
simp_chinese: 奥洛赫加又称斯温斯岛，是托克劳群岛中一座偏远的珊瑚环礁。自1925年起它由美属萨摩亚管理，但它与托克劳的归属关系仍有争议。

english: These Polynesian waters lie in the wider maritime setting north of Samoa. Savai‘i and Upolu form the two principal islands of the neighbouring Samoan group.
simp_chinese: 这片波利尼西亚水域位于萨摩亚以北更广阔的海洋环境中。萨瓦伊与乌波卢构成邻近萨摩亚群岛的两座主要岛屿。

english: Olohose belongs to the wider Lunda country of central Africa. Lunda traditions describe the emergence of paramount rulers bearing the title Mwane-a-Yamvu, within a commonwealth whose core lay in Katanga.
simp_chinese: 奥洛霍塞属于中非更广阔的隆达地区。隆达传统讲述了使用姆瓦内—亚—亚姆武称号的最高统治者的出现，这一共同体的核心位于加丹加。

english: Olomouc grew from an early medieval fortified settlement into a seat of Moravian government and an important bishopric, established in 1063. The medieval city became a major centre of trade and power, competing with Brno for precedence within Moravia. King Wenceslas III was assassinated here in 1306 while preparing to pursue his claim to the Polish crown, ending the male Přemyslid royal line. Later royal gatherings gave the town renewed prominence: Matthias Corvinus was elected king of Bohemia here in 1469, and the settlement of 1479 divided rule between him and Vladislaus II.
simp_chinese: 奥洛穆茨从中世纪早期的设防聚落成长为摩拉维亚的统治中心，并于1063年设立重要主教区。中世纪城市成为贸易与权力的重镇，与布尔诺争夺摩拉维亚的首要地位。1306年，瓦茨拉夫三世在这里准备前往波兰争取王位时遇刺，普热米斯尔王朝的男性王系随之终结。后来的王室会议再次凸显此城的重要性：1469年，马加什·科尔维努斯在这里被选为波希米亚国王；1479年的协议则在他与弗拉迪斯拉夫二世之间划分了统治权。

english: Olonets stands at the meeting of the Olonka and Megrega rivers east of Lake Ladoga. Mentioned in a Novgorodian document in 1137, it gained a fortress in 1649 and became an important market for Russian trade with Sweden.
simp_chinese: 奥洛涅茨位于拉多加湖以东、奥隆卡河与梅格雷加河汇流处。1137年的诺夫哥罗德文书已提到这里，1649年兴建堡垒后，它又成为俄国对瑞典贸易的重要市场。

english: Olongki belongs to the Bureya country within the wider Amur basin. This region formed part of the broad historical geography of Manchuria, extending beyond today’s northeastern China. Its northern territories later became known as Outer Manchuria after their transfer from Qing to Russian rule.
simp_chinese: 鄂隆奇属于广义黑龙江流域的布列亚地区。这片区域处在历史满洲的广阔地理范围内，超出今中国东北。其北方领土在从清朝转入俄国统治后，被称为外满洲。

english: Ölöökö Küöl belongs to Yakutia’s wider eastern Siberian setting. Eastern Siberia stretches east from the Yenisei toward the Pacific watershed and covers about 7.2 million square kilometres. Northern tundra is one of the major landscapes within this broad region.
simp_chinese: 厄勒厄勒克湖属于雅库特的广大东西伯利亚背景。东西伯利亚从叶尼塞河向东延至太平洋分水岭，面积约七百二十万平方公里。北方苔原是这片广大地区的主要景观之一。

english: Oloron grew from Roman Iluro on the road between Dax and Zaragoza. In 1080, the viscount of Béarn founded a fortified town across the river from the episcopal settlement of Sainte-Marie. The two communities became rivals, while textile production and trade with Spain supported Oloron's prosperity.
simp_chinese: 奥洛龙起源于达克斯通往萨拉戈萨道路上的罗马聚落伊卢罗。1080年，贝阿恩子爵在主教驻地圣玛丽的河对岸修建设防城镇。两个聚落此后相互竞争，纺织业与对西班牙贸易支撑着奥洛龙的繁荣。

english: Olovo takes its name from lead, the ore that made it a mining town in medieval Bosnia. A record of 1382 calls it Plumbum, the Latin word for the same metal. The settlement belonged to the lands of the Pavlović family and lies on the route between Sarajevo and Tuzla.
simp_chinese: 奥洛沃因铅得名，正是这种矿石使它成为中世纪波斯尼亚的矿业城镇。1382年的记载称其为Plumbum，同样是拉丁语的“铅”。聚落曾属于帕夫洛维奇家族领地，位于萨拉热窝与图兹拉之间的道路上。

english: Olšnica, later Murska Sobota, lies near the Mura River in the Prekmurje country. Recorded in 1297, the town belonged to Hungary's Vas County; its Hungarian name refers to Saturday, recalling the weekly fairs held on that day.
simp_chinese: 奥尔什尼察，后称穆尔斯卡索博塔，位于普雷克穆列地区的穆拉河附近。1297年已有记载，曾属于匈牙利的沃什州；匈牙利语地名中的星期六，保留了每周在这一天举行集市的记忆。

english: Olsztyn grew beside the Łyna River around a fortified settlement in Warmia. A castle was begun in 1349, and the cathedral chapter granted the town municipal rights in 1353, laying the foundations of the settlement also known as Allenstein.
simp_chinese: 奥尔什丁围绕瓦尔米亚地区维纳河畔的设防聚落成长。城堡于1349年开始兴建，主教座堂参事会于1353年授予城市权利，奠定了这座又称阿伦施泰因的城镇的基础。

english: Oltu preserves a castle with an inscription dated to the seventh century. The fortress town once belonged to the Armenian Mamikonian lords before passing into other hands.
simp_chinese: 奥尔图保存着一座带有7世纪铭文的城堡。这座要塞城镇曾属于亚美尼亚的马米科尼扬贵族，后来转入其他统治者手中。

english: Olvera occupies an elevated site in the hill country of northwestern Cádiz. Near the borders of Seville and Málaga, its white buildings form part of Andalusia’s characteristic landscape of hill towns.
simp_chinese: 奥尔维拉坐落于加的斯西北丘陵的一处高地，邻近塞维利亚与马拉加边界。白色建筑构成了安达卢西亚山城景观的一部分。

english: The Olympic Coast belongs to the northwestern Pacific shore of North America. The wider Washington and Oregon coast has an oceanic climate with winter rainfall, while cool Pacific currents help moderate coastal summer temperatures.
simp_chinese: 奥林匹克海岸属于北美太平洋西北岸。更广阔的华盛顿与俄勒冈沿海拥有冬季多雨的海洋性气候，凉爽太平洋洋流有助于缓和海岸夏季温度。

sources.title: West Coast of the United States

english: Olyokma Upplands belongs to the wider East Siberian region. Its broad geographical setting lies between the Yenisei and the Pacific watershed, where extensive plateaus contrast with mountain belts and tundra.
simp_chinese: 奥廖克马高地属于更广阔的东西伯利亚地区。其广大的地理背景位于叶尼塞河与太平洋水系分水岭之间，辽阔高原与山带、苔原相互交错。

english: The Olyokma Uplands belong to the southern highland setting of Eastern Siberia. Across the broader region, mountain ranges contrast with the Central Siberian Plateau and northern tundra. Eastern Siberia encompasses Yakutia and the territories around and beyond Lake Baikal.
